About the role

We seek a qualified Technical Support Engineer to ensure our customers have exceptional experience with SimpleMDG. You will provide top-notch technical support, assist in troubleshooting several types of technical issues, and offer professional guidance to help customers make the most of our product. Your dedication to customer happiness is crucial to our mission of delivering high-quality service and cultivating long-term customer relationships. Standout candidates will be excellent problem-solvers with outstanding communication and customer service skills.

Customer Support & Ticket Management

- Receive, analyze, prioritize, and triage customer inquiries, incidents, bugs, and service requests.

- Own support cases end-to-end, from initial response through resolution and closure.

- Manage ticket queues effectively while adhering to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and support processes.
- Provide regular and proactive updates to customers throughout the ticket lifecycle.

Technical Troubleshooting & Resolution

- Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application and system issues independently whenever possible.
- Collect logs, reproduce issues, identify root causes, and document findings before escalating.
- Escalate complex incidents, defects, and system issues to the Tech SWAT team with complete diagnostic information and business impact assessment.
- Validate fixes and coordinate customer confirmation before closing tickets.

Incident & Escalation Management

- Participate in incident management activities for production issues and service disruptions.
- Coordinate cross-functional with Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders during major incidents.
- Follow internal Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) and escalation procedures to ensure customer SLAs are met.
- Contribute to post-incident reviews and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities.

Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Management

- Proactively identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to products, processes, and support operations.
- Create, maintain, and improve internal documentation and customer-facing Knowledge Base (KB) articles.
- Contribute to automation opportunities and self-service initiatives to improve customer experience and reduce support effort.
- Assist in defining and refining support processes, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.

Operational Support

- Participate in shift rotations and on-call support when required to support international customers.

- Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
- Strong communication skills, customer empathy, and ownership mindset.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues systematically.
- Proactive attitude and a genuine willingness to learn complex systems and business processes quickly.

title: Technical Lead (Payment/Marketplace/AI)
reasons:
- AI-first company shaping the future of fitness
- Join a passionate global team across VN, US, & UK
- Collaborative team valuing joy & creativity
jobDescription:
About Everfit

Everfit is one of the fastest growing fitness coaching platforms in the world. We power more than 300,000 coaches across the globe with an all-in-one AI-powered platform to run and grow their businesses. In 5 years, we have become one of the leaders of the health and wellness B2B SaaS category in the US and around the world! We are at an inflection point. Having achieved an eight figure ARR business, we are focusing our efforts to capture more of the $4-5 trillion health and fitness market by going direct to consumers. Our vision is to become the operating system for personal health, where anyone can plug in a coach, or multiple coaches, to reach their wellness goals faster, optimize their human potential, and extend their longevity.

Our team spans from San Francisco to Vietnam, with senior leaders who have built and scaled products at Netflix, Apple, Meta, Nike, Hulu, Uber, Amazon, Hypebeast, and Quibi. We are building the next unicorn to come out of Vietnam, and we are looking for a confident leader who can help us get there.

Position Overview:

Location: Hanoi or Da Nang office. If you are based in Ho Chi Minh City, 2-3 weeks per month in Da Nang or Hanoi office (Open for discussion)Our Vietnam team is the engine of Everfit. Currently around 170 people, roughly 150 in Da Nang and 20 in Hanoi, who built the product that’s made us a category leader in 5 years since launch .

The next chapter is about unlocking what this team is capable of — moving faster but with extreme precision, building with AI in every workflow, and operating at the level of the best companies in the world.We’re looking for a Tech Lead who can elevate our engineering team from strong to exceptional. You will drive technical excellence, lead the adoption of AI across engineering workflows and products, mentor and grow our developers, and help build a high-performance engineering culture. Working closely with product, design, and leadership teams across Vietnam and the US, you will align technical execution with business goals and ensure the team delivers impactful solutions with speed, quality, and scalability.WHAT YOU'LL LEAD

You will set technical direction across 2 of Everfit's highest-priority initiatives.

- Payments: Own the technical direction for billing infrastructure: subscription lifecycle, payment gateways (Stripe and beyond), webhook reliability, and financial reconciliation at scale. Guide the squad through multi-currency, cross-border flows, and marketplace payout systems while maintaining financial data integrity.
- Marketplace: Drive backend architecture for discovery, listing management, search/ranking, and transactional flows. Design two-sided systems that scale from thousands to millions of users, covering matching, availability, dynamic pricing, and booking state, with seamless Payments integration.

Your impact

Technical Direction & Architecture

- Own the architectural patterns and technical standards for Marketplace and Payment's backend systems — workout programming engines, scheduling logic, nutrition tracking, multi-tenant platform infrastructure, notification pipelines, and third-party integrations.
- Drive solution design for complex features: new product areas, cross-squad integrations, platform-level changes, and performance-critical systems.
- Make architectural decisions that balance delivery velocity with long-term maintainability.
- Define and uphold engineering standards across squads: API design, data modeling, testing practices, code review culture, and documentation.
- Proactively identify and lead reduction of technical debt in coordination with Engineering Management and Product.

Hands-on Engineering

- Stay in the code on the most critical work — Marketplace and Payment platform infrastructure, high-risk migrations, cross-squad technical foundations, and architectural proof-of-concepts.
- Review pull requests across sub-squads with depth and speed, giving feedback that helps engineers grow — not just ships.
- Set the standard for what good code looks like across squads: observable, testable, maintainable, and scalable.

AI-First Engineering

- Champion AI-assisted development across squads — from code generation and test writing to automated documentation and PR reviews.
- Collaborate with the AI squad on integrating AI features directly into workflows: smart programming suggestions, automated progress summaries, AI-powered onboarding.
- Help engineers build practical AI fluency through pairing, demos, and shared tooling workflows.

Mentorship & Team Growth

- Mentor and coach engineers across squads — raising the technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and technical pairing.
- Run regular technical discussions and design reviews that help engineers grow as system thinkers, not just feature builders.
- Contribute to hiring across Payment and Marketplace: design technical assessments and conduct engineering interviews calibrated to the Marketplace and Payment domain.

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Be the primary technical voice in product discovery across Marketplace and Payment — shaping what's feasible, what's scalable, and what will cause pain six months from now.
- Partner closely with PMs, BAs, QA Lead, and Design to ensure technical decisions translate cleanly into user-facing product quality.
- Align with Tech Leads in other squads (Marketplace, Payment, AI) on shared infrastructure, platform standards, and cross-squad integrations.
- Represent Payment and Marketplace Engineering in cross-functional leadership discussions, communicating system decisions with clarity to non-technical stakeholders.
requirements:
Ideal Candidate Background

- US/UK education or international experience is highly preferred. We value leaders who bring a global perspective, have been exposed to high-performing organizations, and can combine international best practices with a deep understanding of Vietnam's talent and culture. This unique blend of experience will help us continue building a world-class company and team.
- You have a real engineering and product background. You understand how software gets built and you can earn the respect of builders

Must-Have

- 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with 2+ years in a Tech Lead or equivalent role. Former startup founders, or engineers from highly entrepreneurial environments.
- Deep backend fundamentals: distributed systems, data modeling, event-driven architectures, API design, scalability, and reliability.
- Hands-on experience in at least two of the four initiative domains: payments/fintech, marketplace/platform, B2B SaaS, or AI/LLM engineering.
- A track record of designing maintainable systems and raising the technical bar across teams.
- Strong English communication skills and an AI-first engineering mindset.

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with: Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, or equivalent.
- Experience in high-growth startups or distributed teams across time zones (Vietnam and US).
benefits:
Compensation & Benefits:

- Full social insurance coverage and premium healthcare benefits.
- Competitive salary with 13th-month pay and performance bonus.
- Paid leave: vacation, sick leave, and maternity leave

Build Your Career with Impact:

- Be part of a mission-driven company that’s transforming human potential.
- Empower over 300,000+ coaches in more than 200 countries - including Olympic athletes, military trainers, rehab specialists, and celebrity coaches.
- Make a global impact while building a meaningful, purpose-driven career.
- Continuous training, mentoring.
- 1-2 performance reviews annually.

Work Environment:

- Work alongside world-class talent from companies like Apple, Meta, Uber, Patreon, and Nike, united by a shared passion for impact and excellence.
- International team for global career growth.
- State-of-the-art equipment provided.
- Beautiful working environment near Danang's city center (Dragon Bridge) and Hanoi office.

Health & Wellness:

title: [Remote] 3D Game Prototype Developer (Unity/English)
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Unity developer who can turn casual/hypercasual game ideas into playable 3D prototypes quickly, taking a concept to a testable build in days, not months. You'll work on fast iteration loops to validate the "fun factor" of mechanics similar to puzzle, sorting, merge, and arcade-style mobile games.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Rapidly build playable 3D game prototypes on Unity from concepts, references, or design briefs.
- Reproduce and adapt core gameplay mechanics from reference games to test new variations.
- Implement core loops, level systems, and basic UI fast, prioritizing playability over polish.
- Iterate quickly on mechanics, difficulty, and feel based on playtest feedback and metrics.
- Meet with the design team to scope ideas, clarify specifications, and propose technical approaches.
- Collaborate closely with Game Artists to integrate 3D assets, animations, and effects.
- Set up lightweight, reusable prototype templates and a development pipeline to speed up future projects.
- Write clean, efficient, and modular code that can be extended if a prototype gets greenlit.
- Ensure prototypes run smoothly on target mobile devices (stable framerate, reasonable load times).
- Identify and resolve gameplay bugs and performance bottlenecks quickly.
- Propose and implement technical solutions in a timely manner.
- Conduct white-box testing on prototype builds before handoff.
requirements:
REQUIREMENT

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
- 2–4 years of experience as a Unity Developer, ideally including mobile game development.
- Hands-on experience building casual/hypercasual or puzzle-style games (a portfolio of prototypes or shipped titles is strongly preferred).
- Comfortable working in fast iteration cycles and an Agile/Scrum environment.
- Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding.

SKILLS

- Proficiency in C# and the Unity engine.
- Solid grasp of 3D fundamentals: scripting, physics, animation, materials/textures, GUI styles, and scene management.
- Ability to quickly reverse-engineer and reimplement gameplay mechanics from reference games.
- Skill in optimizing memory and performance for mobile devices.
- Ability to use AI tools effectively to improve productivity and development workflow.
- Good English reading and writing skills for collaboration in an international environment.

ABILITIES

- Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting abilities.
- Ability to critically evaluate and adapt AI-generated solutions.
- A bias toward speed and experimentation, shipping a rough playable beats a perfect plan.
- Open-mindedness and willingness to learn and explore new technologies.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Strong work ethic and trustworthiness.
benefits:

- Fully remote team, no traffic jam, no rigid office hours.
- Regular discussions and a chance to learn directly from experts in their fields.
- International exposure and real opportunity to grow.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm nhân tài cho vị trí Expert Information Security để trực tiếp dẫn dắt chiến lược bảo mật sản phẩm và hạ tầng Cloud ở quy mô lớn. Vai trò này đòi hỏi sự kết hợp giữa tư duy kiến trúc hệ thống, năng lực kỹ thuật chuyên sâu và khả năng đồng kiến tạo (co-create) cùng các đội ngũ Phát triển Sản phẩm (Engineering/Product) nhằm thực thi nguyên tắc Security-by-Design trong toàn bộ vòng đời phát triển.

I: Trách nhiệm & Phạm vi Ảnh hưởng

1. Kiến trúc An ninh Sản phẩm (Product Security & Architecture)

- Chủ trì thực hiện Security Architecture Review và Threat Modeling cho các hệ thống và dịch vụ trọng yếu của hệ sinh thái.
- Định hình các phương án thiết kế bảo mật tối ưu, đảm bảo sự cân bằng giữa tính an toàn, trải nghiệm người dùng và tốc độ vận hành kinh doanh.

2. Vận hành An ninh Ứng dụng & DevSecOps

- Tự động hoá quy trình kiểm soát an ninh (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC Scanning, SBOM) vào hệ thống CI/CD.
- Điều phối các hoạt động rà soát mã nguồn (Secure Code Review), Pentest.
- Quản trị rủi ro và ưu tiên xử lý lỗ hổng dựa trên phân tích tác động thực tế tới doanh nghiệp.

3. An ninh Hạ tầng Cloud & Platform

- Thiết kế và rà soát các chốt chặn an ninh trên Cloud (GCP/AWS), hướng tới quản trị Multi-cloud bền vững.
- Tư vấn triển khai chuyên sâu về IAM Hardening, Network Security, Workload Isolation và Data Protection.
- Đảm bảo an ninh cho môi trường Kubernetes, Container Platform và hạ tầng mã hoá (IaC).

4. Quản trị Rủi ro, Tuân thủ & Công nghệ Mới

- Đảm bảo an ninh dữ liệu và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2).
- Nghiên cứu và đánh giá rủi ro cho các công nghệ tiên phong: AI/ML Security, Blockchain, Automation.
- Dẫn dắt các hoạt động Security Research, chia sẻ tri thức và xây dựng cộng đồng bảo mật nội bộ.

5. Dẫn dắt & Phát triển Năng lực (Leadership & Enablement)

- Cố vấn (Mentor) và phát triển chuyên môn cho các thành viên trong đội ngũ Security.
- Xây dựng hệ thống Playbook, Security Patterns và hướng dẫn lập trình an toàn (Secure Coding Practices).
- Thúc đẩy văn hoá an ninh thông tin xuyên suốt các đơn vị kinh doanh và khối kỹ thuật.

Quản lý các hoạt động bảo mật dữ liệu theo vòng đời dữ liệu (data lifecycle):• Phân loại và gắn nhãn dữ liệu (Data Classification & Tagging)• Mã hóa và quản lý khóa (Encryption & Key Management)• Ẩn danh, che dấu dữ liệu (Masking, Tokenization)• Quản lý truy cập và phân quyền (Access Control, IAM, ABAC/RBAC)• Giám sát và phát hiện rò rỉ dữ liệu (DLP, Monitoring, Incident Response)iii. Xây dựng và cập nhật chính sách, quy trình, tiêu chuẩn bảo mật dữ liệu, phối hợp chặt chẽ với các đơn vị IT Security, Data Governance, QTRR và Tuân thủ.iv. Tham gia triển khai, đánh giá và kiểm soát tuân thủ các quy định pháp luật về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân và bảo mật thông tin.v. Đào tạo, nâng cao nhận thức về bảo mật dữ liệu cho các đơn vị kinh doanh và kỹ thuật.vi. Xây dựng báo cáo định kỳ về tình hình an ninh dữ liệu, cảnh báo sớm rủi ro và kế hoạch cải thiện cho Ban Lãnh đạo.

title: Project Manager
jobDescription:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and sprint reviews to ensure the team stays on track and adheres to Scrum processes.
- Provide ongoing guidance and coaching to team members on Scrum principles, practices, and agile methodologies, ensuring continuous improvement.
- Ensure that the Scrum process is being followed, removing any impediments, and providing support for the team’s adherence.
- Work closely with development teams and other stakeholders, especially the Japan-based teams, to align product goals and deliverables.
- Help the Product Owner prioritize the product backlog and ensure that the team has a clear understanding of requirements, goals, and scope.
- Provides timely technical solutions and communicates them clearly to the Product Owner to support informed decision-making during meetings.
- Lead the team in sprint planning meetings, helping to define sprint goals, and ensuring tasks are well defined and achievable within the sprint.
- Coordinate sprint releases, ensuring that all tasks are completed according to the agreed timeline and aligned with the global product roadmap.
- Identify and address any roadblocks preventing the team from achieving sprint goals and removing impediments that affect productivity.
- Provide status reports to the leadership team, including the Japan-based stakeholders, highlighting sprint progress, challenges, and solutions.
- Monitors and enforces quality standards across the product lifecycle.
requirements:
QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.
- Proficient communication and comprehension skills in English.
- Relevant project management certification (e.g., PMP, Scrum Master) is preferred.
- At least 3 years of experience in Scrum Master/ Project Manager in the software industry.
- Prior experience in the finance domain is a plus.
- Knowledge and practical experience as a Scrum Master are required, including facilitating agile ceremonies, managing sprint planning, and supporting agile team productivity.
- Demonstrates strong knowledge of system design principles.
- Familiarity with software development languages, frameworks, and methodologies.
- Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects concurrently using project management tools.
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and lead within cross-functional teams.
- Strong problem-solving abilities, critical thinking, and keen attention to detail.
- Good logical and analytical thinking skills.
benefits:
BENEFITS

- Attractive income package
- 13th-month salary
- Annual salary review and performance appraisal
- Coverage of social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance based on level
- Company-sponsored annual health check-ups
- Regular team-building events and company outings
- Enhance your communication skills with company-sponsored English and Japanese classes
- Sponsored professional learning and development opportunities
- International travel opportunities available for certain roles
- Access to cutting-edge technologies in product environment

Working hour

- 8:00 – 12:00 | 13:00 – 17:00 Monday to Friday

Address: 2nd Floor, Tan Cuong Building, 47 Nui Thanh St, Hoa Cuong Ward, Da Nang City, Viet Nam

MS/ESC XC Horizontal ENE

The organization owns horizontal topics such as base software, middleware, safety, security, compute, and engineering methods, supporting XC‑CP, XC‑CE, XC‑AC, and XC‑AS products. Work as part of Bosch’s global ADAS teams to develop and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW and diagnostics software for next‑generation driver assistance ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, domain controllers).

- Develop and maintain embedded AUTOSAR Classic software (BSW and low‑level SW) for ADAS ECUs using C/C++.

- Use tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, debuggers, emulators, and simulators for development, analysis, and issue resolution.

- Participate in technical discussions in an international, distributed team; and actively provide innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.

Phần hỗ trợ IT nội bộ chiếm khoảng 10–20% thời gian, chủ yếu nhằm đảm bảo môi trường làm việc và hạ tầng nội bộ ổn định. Trọng tâm chính của vị trí vẫn là DevOps / production operations cho sản phẩm phần mềm.

Trách nhiệm chính:

- Triển khai và vận hành ứng dụng trên các môi trường dev, staging, production.
- Quản lý và theo dõi server, container, dịch vụ nền, reverse proxy và các thành phần liên quan trong hệ thống.
- Thiết lập và duy trì hệ thống monitoring, logging, alerting để theo dõi tình trạng hạ tầng và ứng dụng.
- Hỗ trợ quá trình release phần mềm, bảo đảm deploy an toàn, có kiểm soát, có khả năng rollback khi cần.
- Xây dựng và duy trì pipeline CI/CD tự động hóa build, test và triển khai.
- Phân tích, xử lý và phối hợp khắc phục các sự cố phát sinh trên môi trường vận hành.
- Quản lý cấu hình môi trường, domain, SSL/TLS, certificate, secret và quyền truy cập hệ thống.
- Xây dựng, thực hiện và kiểm tra quy trình backup/restore cho ứng dụng và cơ sở dữ liệu.
- Viết và duy trì tài liệu vận hành, runbook, SOP, checklist release, checklist sự cố.
- Phối hợp với team phát triển để chuẩn hóa cách đóng gói, triển khai và theo dõi ứng dụng sau release.
- Hỗ trợ chuẩn bị các nội dung kỹ thuật liên quan đến vận hành, log, sao lưu, truy vết thay đổi và an toàn hệ thống khi cần.

Hỗ trợ IT nội bộ (kiêm nhiệm)

- Hỗ trợ xử lý sự cố máy tính, thiết bị và phần mềm cho nhân viên nội bộ.
- Quản lý và bảo trì hệ thống mạng nội bộ (LAN/WiFi, switch, router, VPN) và đường truyền.
- Quản lý server nội bộ, tài khoản người dùng, phân quyền và thiết bị dùng chung (máy in, NAS…).
requirements:
Kinh nghiệm:

- Có từ 2–3 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí DevOps, System Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer hoặc tương đương (hoặc ít hơn nếu kinh nghiệm vận hành production thực tế tương đương).
- Có kinh nghiệm thực tế trong deploy và vận hành production cho hệ thống web, API hoặc dịch vụ backend.

Kỹ năng bắt buộc:

- Thành thạo Linux server administration.
- Có kinh nghiệm tốt với Docker, Docker Compose hoặc công cụ tương đương.
- Có kinh nghiệm cấu hình và vận hành Nginx hoặc reverse proxy tương đương.
- Theo dõi và xử lý được các sự cố vận hành: tài nguyên (CPU / RAM / disk / network), crash process/service, lỗi ứng dụng sau deploy, lỗi kết nối giữa các service.
- Có khả năng viết shell script hoặc script tự động hóa cơ bản phục vụ triển khai và vận hành.

Cần biết để làm tốt

jobDescription:

title: Senior Fullstack Dev (Java, Spring Boot, VueJS, AI)
reasons:
- Chuyên gia hàng đầu trong lĩnh vực AI và BigData
- Môi trường làm việc quốc tế
- Thu nhập không giới hạn thỏa thuận theo năng lực
jobDescription:
Giới thiệu

Saltlux Technology là chi nhánh tại Việt Nam của Saltlux Inc. (Hàn Quốc), tập trung vào các sản phẩm/giải pháp về AI và Big Data. Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm Senior Fullstack Developer để cùng xây dựng các nền tảng dữ liệu quy mô lớn và ứng dụng doanh nghiệp.

Mục tiêu công việc

- Phát triển các dịch vụ/nền tảng web (desktop & mobile) cho bài toán Big Data/Enterprise.
- Đảm bảo chất lượng kỹ thuật: thiết kế, coding standards, khả năng mở rộng và độ ổn định hệ thống.
- Phối hợp hiệu quả với các nhóm tại Việt Nam và Hàn Quốc trong quá trình phát triển sản phẩm.

Mô tả công việc

• Đóng vai trò Sub-leader trong nhóm phát triển (phân công công việc, hỗ trợ kỹ thuật, theo dõi tiến độ hạng mục).

• Thiết kế, phát triển và tối ưu backend bằng Java (Spring Boot/Spring Cloud), xây dựng API theo chuẩn REST.

• Phát triển frontend với Vue.js và các thư viện/framework JavaScript hiện đại.

• Tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế giải pháp và đóng góp quyết định kiến trúc (ưu tiên Microservices).

• Thực hiện code review, viết tài liệu kỹ thuật và phối hợp QA để đảm bảo chất lượng.

• Làm việc và trao đổi thường xuyên với team Việt Nam/Hàn Quốc qua chat, email và hệ thống quản lý tài liệu.

• Các nhiệm vụ khác theo phân công của Quản lý dự án.

Có kinh nghiệm liên quan đến AI là một lợi thế

• Chủ động sử dụng các AI Coding Assistant trong quá trình phát triển phần mềm để nâng cao năng suất và chất lượng sản phẩm.

• Ứng dụng AI trong các hoạt động:

o Phân tích yêu cầu.

o Thiết kế giải pháp.

o Sinh mã nguồn.

o Refactoring.

o Sinh Unit Test.

o Code Review.

o Tạo tài liệu kỹ thuật.

o Phân tích lỗi và tối ưu hệ thống.

• Đề xuất và cải tiến quy trình AI-Assisted Development cho nhóm phát triển.

• Hướng dẫn và hỗ trợ các thành viên trong nhóm sử dụng AI hiệu quả và an toàn.

• Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ khác theo sự phân công của Quản lý dự án.
requirements:
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT/Khoa học máy tính hoặc lĩnh vực liên quan.
- Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm Java web Fullstack; đã tham gia từ 4 dự án web trở lên.
- Có kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt đội nhóm vừa và nhỏ (2-5 thành viên) hoặc chịu trách nhiệm chính cho một hạng mục.
- Frontend: thành thạo Vue.js; nắm vững HTML/CSS/JavaScript (biết React/Angular là điểm cộng).
- Backend: thành thạo Java; Spring Boot, Spring Cloud; hiểu cách thiết kế API, xử lý lỗi và bảo mật cơ bản.
- Am hiểu và có kinh nghiệm áp dụng AI tool, AI Model, AI Best practices , AI workflow framework vào quy trình phát triển phần mềm nhằm tối ưu hóa, nâng cao năng suất coding và review code
- Hiểu và đã từng làm việc với kiến trúc Microservices. Message queue…
- Tiếng Anh tốt (đọc/viết); giao tiếp tiếng Anh là lợi thế lớn.
- Có kinh nghiệm Docker, Kubernestess là lợi thế đáng kể.

Điểm cộng

- Kinh nghiệm làm việc trong môi trường quốc tế, phối hợp đa quốc gia.
- Kinh nghiệm với hệ thống dữ liệu lớn/analytics hoặc các nền tảng enterprise.
benefits:
- Lương gross: 30.000.000 – 45.000.000 VND/tháng (theo năng lực & kinh nghiệm).
- Thưởng hiệu suất, thưởng lễ + lương tháng 13.
- Review lương hằng năm.
- Đóng BHXH đầy đủ khi lên chính thức.
- Khám sức khỏe định kỳ hằng năm.
- 12 ngày phép/năm (linh hoạt sắp xếp).
- Ngân sách cá nhân 100 USD/năm sau 1 năm; trợ cấp y tế 250 USD/năm sau 3 năm.
- Miễn phí gửi xe; snack, trà và cà phê tại văn phòng.
- Môi trường quốc tế, khuyến khích đổi mới; có cơ hội công tác/làm việc tại Hàn Quốc.

title: AWS Solution Architecture (Cloud, System Architecture)
reasons:
- Remote-Friendly
- International Team
- Coaching to grow career
jobDescription:
We are looking for an AWS Solution Architect to join an enterprise digital platform project in the banking domain.

This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on AWS experience who is ready to take greater ownership of solution design and technical delivery. You will collaborate with clients, engineering teams, and cloud specialists to understand requirements, recommend appropriate AWS services, and design scalable, secure, and reliable solutions while supporting their successful implementation.

📍Work Location: Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi

Responsibilities

- Work with clients and internal teams to understand business requirements, existing infrastructure, and technical challenges.
- Assess client needs and recommend suitable AWS services and solution approaches.
- Design cloud infrastructure and solution architecture on AWS.
- Define architecture and integration approaches for systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, batch processing, and real-time processing.
- Review technical designs to ensure scalability, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
- Support cloud implementation, migration, and modernization projects from solution design through delivery.
- Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, and DevOps teams to translate solution designs into practical implementation plans.
- Support technical discovery, effort estimation, risk assessment, and dependency identification.
- Prepare architecture diagrams, technical documents, and implementation recommendations.
- Communicate technical options and trade-offs clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

📍Work location: Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi
requirements:
- 3-5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, AWS cloud implementation, cloud migration, infrastructure architecture, or solution architecture.
- Strong hands-on experience working with AWS and designing solutions for production environments.
- Good understanding of AWS services across compute, networking, storage, databases, security, IAM, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.
- Ability to recommend suitable AWS services based on client requirements, system constraints, and business objectives.
- Experience with API integration, microservices, or event-driven architecture.
- Familiarity with cloud migration, modernization, or enterprise infrastructure projects.
- Ability to create architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
- Good problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills.
- English communication skills sufficient for technical discussions and documentation.

Nice to Have

- AWS certification is highly preferred.
- Candidates with multiple AWS certifications or prior participation in AWS training programs are encouraged to apply.
- Experience working directly with clients or supporting consulting, presales, or solution implementation activities.
- Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, or OpenShift.
- Experience in banking, fintech, or large-scale enterprise projects.
benefits:
- Work on a large-scale enterprise platform with complex architecture and integration challenges.
- Be involved in both solution design and technical delivery.
- Collaborate closely with experienced engineering, DevOps, data, and ML teams.
- Take ownership of meaningful architecture decisions with a direct impact on project delivery.
- Competitive compensation and flexible working arrangements for suitable candidates.

title: Middle Product Designer (UI UX, Figma, HTML, CSS)
jobDescription:
NetSpace đang tìm kiếm Middle Product Designer với tư duy sản phẩm chủ động — người có khả năng xác định đúng vấn đề trước khi đưa ra giải pháp thiết kế.

Trong giai đoạn AI đang tái định hình quy trình phát triển sản phẩm, chúng tôi đề cao những ứng viên biết ứng dụng công cụ mới để tối ưu hiệu suất, rút ngắn vòng lặp thử nghiệm và thích nghi linh hoạt với yêu cầu thay đổi.

NetSpace hiện đang phát triển song song bốn sản phẩm: Super App, Sàn Bất động sản, Nền tảng KOL và Phần mềm tòa soạn — môi trường phù hợp với những cá nhân mong muốn đóng góp thực chất và có tác động trực tiếp đến sản phẩm.

MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC

- Thiết kế UI/UX cho các sản phẩm web và mobile trong hệ sinh thái NetSpace, bao gồm: Super App, Sàn Bất động sản, Nền tảng KOL và Phần mềm tòa soạn.
- Chuyển hóa yêu cầu nghiệp vụ từ Product Manager và các bên liên quan thành wireframe, prototype và bản thiết kế hoàn chỉnh.
- Tham gia các hoạt động nghiên cứu người dùng (user research, usability testing); tổng hợp insight và ứng dụng vào thiết kế.
- Xây dựng và duy trì Design System, component library nhằm đảm bảo tính nhất quán về giao diện và trải nghiệm trên toàn bộ sản phẩm.
- Phối hợp với đội ngũ kỹ sư Frontend trong quá trình bàn giao thiết kế (design handoff), đảm bảo chất lượng triển khai đúng với ý định thiết kế ban đầu.
- Ứng dụng các công cụ AI trong quy trình làm việc hàng ngày nhằm tăng tốc độ ideation, prototyping và nghiên cứu.
- Chủ động phân tích bài toán sản phẩm, đề xuất hướng giải quyết — không chỉ tiếp nhận yêu cầu và thực thi.
requirements:
Kinh nghiệm & kỹ năng cứng

- 2 – 4 năm kinh nghiệm thiết kế sản phẩm số (UI/UX Design), đã từng ra mắt sản phẩm thực tế.
- Thành thạo Figma (auto-layout, component, variant, prototyping, dev mode).
- Hiểu về UX fundamentals: information architecture, user flow, usability heuristics.
- Có kiến thức cơ bản về Frontend (HTML/CSS) để giao tiếp hiệu quả với kỹ sư.
- Portfolio thể hiện rõ quy trình tư duy thiết kế (design thinking), không chỉ giao diện đẹp.

Tư duy & thái độ

Ứng viên phù hợp:

- Có khả năng triển khai nhanh — từ yêu cầu đến bản thiết kế đầu tiên trong thời gian ngắn.
- Làm việc hiệu quả trong môi trường đa dự án, linh hoạt thích nghi với sự thay đổi.
- Ứng dụng AI như một công cụ chuyên môn trong quy trình làm việc thường ngày.
- Cởi mở tiếp nhận và chủ động cải tiến phương pháp làm việc khi có hướng tiếp cận tốt hơn.
- Có tư duy phản biện — đặt câu hỏi về tính đúng đắn của bài toán trước khi bắt tay vào thiết kế.

Ứng viên không phù hợp:

- Yêu cầu môi trường làm việc ổn định, tập trung một dự án duy nhất với kế hoạch cố định.
- Chỉ bắt đầu triển khai khi có đầy đủ brief và thông tin.
- Nhìn nhận thiết kế thuần túy là công việc thực thi thẩm mỹ, không gắn với mục tiêu sản phẩm.
benefits:
- Mức lương cạnh tranh, thỏa thuận theo năng lực thực tế.
- Hỗ trợ ăn trưa 55.000 VNĐ/suất tại nhà hàng Công ty; hỗ trợ chi phí gửi xe.
- Thưởng hiệu quả công việc; thưởng Lễ, Tết và các chế độ phúc lợi theo quy định Công ty.
- Tham gia đầy đủ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo quy định pháp luật.
- Chế độ nghỉ phép năm; các hoạt động du lịch, team building, sinh nhật và văn hóa nội bộ.
- Môi trường làm việc năng động, chú trọng cập nhật xu hướng Công nghệ và ứng dụng AI trong thực tiễn.
- Cơ hội làm việc trực tiếp trên các sản phẩm thương mại đang vận hành, có tác động thực tế đến người dùng.

title: Middle Manual Tester (QA QC, Postman, Agile/Scrum)
jobDescription:
Đảm bảo chất lượng sản phẩm phần mềm thông qua việc kiểm thử thủ công, phát hiện lỗi, tối ưu trải nghiệm người dùng và phối hợp chặt chẽ với các bộ phận phát triển, sản phẩm và khách hàng.

- Phối hợp chặt chẽ với BA, Developer, Product Owner để hiểu rõ yêu cầu và xác định phạm vi test.
- Tham gia UAT (User Acceptance Test) và hỗ trợ người dùng nội bộ/khách hàng trong giai đoạn nghiệm thu.
- Tham gia hoặc hỗ trợ vai trò Scrum Master:Điều phối daily standup, sprint review, retrospective (khi được phân công).Theo dõi tiến độ sprint và hỗ trợ loại bỏ các trở ngại (impediments).
- Điều phối daily standup, sprint review, retrospective (khi được phân công).
- Theo dõi tiến độ sprint và hỗ trợ loại bỏ các trở ngại (impediments).

title: Solution Architect
jobDescription:
About This Role

You will serve as the strategic technical extension of the CTO in Finland, acting as the primary technical authority for our Vietnam operations. This role demands a blend of deep architectural design, hands-on technical leadership, and commercial consulting. You will bridge the gap between Finland’s strategic vision and local execution, ensuring all software consulting projects meet Nordic quality standards.

What You Will Do

1. Technical Leadership & CTO Support

- CTO Representation: Act as the technical leader for the Vietnam office, reporting directly to the CTO in Finland to ensure alignment on all technical strategies.
- Team Management: Provide technical oversight for developers, ensuring high-quality output and adherence to architectural standards.
- Recruitment & Growth: Lead the technical hiring process in Vietnam, including CV screening and conducting interviews to build a high-performing engineering team.
- Practice Development: Organize technical training sessions and ensure consistent quality across all Vietnam-based projects.

2. Solution Design & Architecture

- System Design Capability: Lead end-to-end design across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments, focusing on robust software designer principles.
- Architecture Frameworks: Develop HLDs, LLDs, and integration patterns (APIs, microservices) that align with enterprise standards.
- Security & Compliance: Ensure all solutions comply with GDPR, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 security best practices.

3. Presales & Consulting

- Sales Collaboration: Partner with the Sales team to participate in discovery workshops and technical preparation meetings.
- Technical Feasibility: Consult on the practicality and feasibility of proposed solutions, providing ROM estimates and multi-year business cases.
- Stakeholder Management: Build “trusted advisor” relationships with European clients and CXO-level stakeholders.
requirements:
Technical Skills

- 7+ years in IT (including 2+ years as Solution Architect or Technical Lead)
- Proven Architectural Capability: Deep experience as a Solution Architect or Software Designer, with the ability to translate complex business needs into technical reality.
- Software Engineering Background: A strong technical foundation with significant experience delivering high-quality software consulting projects.
- Modern Tech Stack: Proficiency in Azure Cloud Architecture, Microservices, API Design, and DevSecOps/CI/CD.
- Lifecycle Mastery: Experience spanning the full presales-to-delivery lifecycle.

Soft Skills

- Recruitment & Mentorship: Ability to identify top talent and mentor junior to mid-level engineers.
- Excellent English: Exceptional communication skills to collaborate with the Finland CTO and European clients.
- Commercial Acumen: Understanding of TCO, ROI, and various commercial models like T&M vs. fixed-price.
- Cultural Integration: Comfortable working in an environment that blends Finnish and Vietnamese work cultures
benefits:
BENEFIT

- At Tekai Vietnam, we build a working environment based on trust, proactiveness, transparency, and respect for individuals, reflecting the cultural integration between Vietnam and Finland.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Salary review 1–2 times per year, based on performance, level of contribution, and role maturity.
- A minimum of 13 months’ salary per year, along with performance bonuses, business performance bonuses, and bonuses for public holidays, Lunar New Year, and other special occasions.
- Annual company trips and team-building activities, organized with a focus on balance and internal connection.
- Full social insurance coverage (SI, HI, UI) in accordance with regulations, along with periodic health check-ups.
- Extended health insurance package (applied after one year of employment).
- Provision of full working equipment and tools, supporting job requirements and individual productivity.

WORK-LIFE BALANCE

- Weekly Happy Time every Friday, creating space for connection, sharing, and recharging.
- Employee welfare fund established by the company to support and accompany employees through important life events (meals, birthdays, marriage, childbirth, illness, etc.).

WORKING ENVIRONMENT & DEVELOPMENT

- An open working environment with cultural integration between Finland and Vietnam, encouraging open communication, two-way feedback, and proactive solution proposals.
- Management by objectives and results, empowering employees and allowing them to organize their work in the way that suits them best.
- A strong emphasis on work–life balance, prioritizing quality and a sustainable working pace.

LOCATION & WORKING HOURS

- Location: Dong Do Apartment Building, Nghia Do Street, Nghia Do Ward, Hanoi.
- Working days: 5 days per week, 7.5 working hours per day, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday (including a 1.5-hour lunch break). Days off: Saturdays, Sundays, and Vietnamese public holidays.

title: Senior Data Scientist (ML/AI, MLOps, Python, PyTorch)
jobDescription:
About This Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist specializing in AI and Computer Vision to join Tekai's growing team of specialists. You'll work end-to-end on real-world AI projects — from translating business problems into solution architectures, to building and deploying state-of-the-art computer vision models in production. This role is for someone with deep ML foundations, hands-on CV experience, and the mindset to take ownership of complex technical challenges in close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams.

What You Will Do

- Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, customers, and partners across the full lifecycle of AI projects.
- Translate business and operational needs into AI solution architectures and production-ready ML systems.
- Design, build, and deploy modern computer vision models using deep learning, foundation models, transfer learning, and self-/weakly-supervised approaches.
- Build and manage scalable data pipelines, annotation workflows, and dataset lifecycle processes.
- Validate and test models for robustness and reliability in production environments.
requirements:

- Data and annotation management: pipeline design, quality control, dataset structuring, augmentation, and large-scale image handling.
- Strong Python and Linux-based development skills
- Git-based collaboration workflows.
- MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field
- Bonus: Experience with metric learning, similarity-based modeling, or industrial AI applications under real-world constraints.

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
- Excellent communication skills in English (preferred TOEIC 750+ or IELTS 6.5+)
- Proactive, self-motivated, and detail-oriented
benefits:

title: Senior/Manager Data Intelligence Analyst (Python, SQL)
jobDescription:
We are seeking a skilled Senior Data Intelligence Analyst and Data Manager to join our team in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The ideal candidate should possess strong data literacy, project management, and communication skills. This exciting role will be a key member of a motivated and high-profile team working on cutting-edge solutions.

You will be involved not only in managing client data intelligence and dashboarding solutions end-to-end, but also in contributing to product development, including our successful adoption of AI technologies into internal processes. The candidate should possess strong data processing skills and technical capabilities.

Additionally, this role will eventually involve directly managing projects for major multinational clients worldwide, so knowledge of the digital media industry is an advantage. The candidate should also be comfortable working with both internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to liaise with and present to non-technical audiences.

Key Accountabilities

Data Literacy & Expertise

- Build and manage data reporting solutions using BI platforms such as Looker Studio, Tableau, and Power BI.
- Analyse complex distributed production deployments in Google Cloud Platform and provide recommendations to optimize performance.
- Interpret and analyse large datasets using SQL and Python.
- Provide analytical support in designing, testing, evaluating, implementing, measuring, and monitoring projects.
- Ensure compliance with data management and data governance regulations and policies.

Project Management

- Actively participate in competitive intelligence roadmap discussions and prioritize analysis requests.
- Create and deliver data outputs, customized reports, ad hoc analyses, and data visualizations to support new business pitches across the region.
- Assist in managing and prioritizing multiple projects while maintaining process documentation and procedures to ensure data accuracy.
- Maintain an organized, detail-oriented, and QA-focused approach to work.

Networking & Stakeholder Management

- Build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders across the region.
- Actively participate in managing client requirements, maintaining SLA and SOW documentation, and ensuring team deliverables are met.
- Demonstrate self-motivation in identifying new business opportunities and improving existing client relationships.
requirements:
- Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, are required.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in data processing, data engineering, ETL using SQL, and automation using programming languages such as Python for Senior RoleMinimum 7 years of experience to be qualified for Manager Role
- Knowledge of scripting and programming in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is an added advantage.
- Intermediate-level experience with BI technologies such as Google Looker Studio, Tableau, and Power BI is required.
- Hands-on experience in data integration and manipulation using SQL, BigQuery, and Python. Familiarity with GCP is an added advantage.
- Familiarity with media research platforms such as NetBase, Brandwatch, Similarweb, and Semrush is preferred.
- Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including pivot tables, charts, VLOOKUPs, and dashboard creation.
- Basic understanding of statistical analysis and research methodologies.
- Familiarity with media performance analytics and reporting is an added advantage.
- Self-starter with a high level of motivation and proactiveness.
- Highly organized, with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
- Strong interest in working within a high-profile, results-driven team.
- Interested in the real-world application of AI in the media environment.

title: Sr IT System Admin (Compliance Officer, Microsoft 365)

This role combines system administration, cybersecurity oversight, infrastructure management, vendor coordination, compliance support, and end-user support.

System Administration & Infrastructure Management

- Computer workstations

- Network equipment and firewall systems

jobDescription:
ANDPAD Vietnam is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with strong expertise in software testing and quality assurance for web and mobile applications. This position requires a high level of proficiency in Japanese (N2+) and a strong commitment to maintaining product quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

■ Job Scope

For QA/QC Engineer:

- Perform test analysis, design, execution, and bug reporting at the system test level for Web and Mobile applications.
- Manage test progress, reporting, and bug tracking for individual tasks.
- Participate in upstream processes to execute testing efficiently and identify risks early.
- Propose product improvements from a user-centric quality perspective.
- Implement E2E test automation (No-code/Low-code).

For Senior QA/QC Engineer:

- Formulate test strategies and plans to ensure quality and delivery speed at the team level.
- Perform test analysis, design, execution, and bug reporting at the system test level for Web and Mobile applications.
- Manage test progress, reporting, and bug tracking at the team level.
- Drive SDLC process improvement and "Shift-Left" initiatives based on bug trend and root cause analysis.
- Plan and promote E2E test automation (No-code/Low-code).
- Mentor others and support their professional growth through knowledge sharing.

Development environment

- Automation test: Autify, Magicpod
- Backend: Ruby (on Rails), Go, Amazon Aurora(MySQL), Elasticsearch, DynamoDB
- Frontend: Nuxt.js/Vue.js, ReactJS
- Mobile App: Kotlin, Swift, Flutter
- Deploy/ Build: CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
- Others: swagger, Docker, Figma, Confluence, JIRA, esa
requirements:
Must have:

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in Web or Mobile application testing.
- Strong hands-on experience in test analysis, test design, and test execution based on requirements and specifications.
- Good understanding of QA methodologies (ISTQB certification or equivalent knowledge is preferred).
- Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with Developers and Product Managers.
- Japanese proficiency at N2 level or above (able to read Japanese documentation and communicate with Japanese stakeholders in daily work).

Nice to have:

- Experience in test management within a product team or Agile/Scrum team environment.
- Experience in working with SDLC optimization or Shift-Left quality initiatives.
- Experience in leading or mentoring a manual testing team of 2+ members.
- Experience in test automation.
- Communication skills in English.
- Experience in development projects for Japanese companies.
- Knowledge of business flows in the Architecture/Construction industry.
- Experience in non-functional testing (Security, Performance, etc.).
- Continuous Learning Mindset: A self-driven learner who continuously explores and adopts new technologies and methodologies to stay updated.
benefits:

jobDescription:
JOB PURPOSE

- The quality gatekeeper is responsible for ensuring that software is being delivered with the highest quality standards. The main mission is to reach quality excellence by having no issues in production as a continuous target.
- The QA Engineer should know and understand the business details, being able to check whether the final result matches all the business expectations.
- The QA Engineer should create and execute manual and automated test scenarios, provide root cause analyses of defects based on metrics, and proactively raise improvements that will enhance the quality of the product.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

- As a member of an Agile team: The main responsibility for the quality of the product. Ensure that the product is delivered with the highest quality by leveraging QA activities along with the scrum phases. Some of the daily basis activities are:
- Design test processes and procedures used to ensure that software operates within defined requirements.
- Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
- Implement test plans, automation, and validation strategies.
- Creating and executing test automation scripts (UI testing, API testing, etc).
- In-depth functional testing – Must be able to evaluate functional stability to ensure business requirements are being met and are “fit-for-purpose” through end-to-end functional and automation testing.
- Work closely with developers and product owners/business analysts to resolve issues.
- Communicate any obstacles to raise awareness and avoid project impediments and overall project timeline disruption.
- Collaborate with Product Owner, and Developers on tasks related to the planning, testing, and coordination of release activities.
- Participate in user story creation process through dissection of high-level requirements during team review sessions.
requirements:
SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of work experience in Quality Assurance roles
- Good communication skills in English.
- Experience in writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans and test cases.
- Knowledge of testing integrations, testing best practices, and end-to-end system processes.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Demonstrated ability to think outside the box.
- Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and how QA functions within it.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with test automation tools, such as Selenium, Gherkin, Specflow, Postman, SoapUI, etc.
- Familiarity with git and version control tools.
- Having Salesforce experience/knowledge is a big plus.
benefits:
At OTSV, work is a self-fulfillment, we encourage staff to leave their comfort zone, think out of the box, and share their ideas without hesitation. As a team, we analyze and evaluate issues objectively to learn quickly from mistakes.

We believe in ‘fail quick, success quick’ and strive to keep pace with the forefront of technology to digitize ONE’s business.

The designs of our offices embrace our culture of being flexible and open. Unlike a conventional office, we have an open concept with different work areas which encourages collaboration, open-mindedness, and spontaneity.

Each work area has its charm and aims to make our staff feel as comfortable in the office as they would feel at home. Have a meet-up at the Café amidst the aroma of coffee!

You will love working here!

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure, dbt, Microsoft Fabric)
jobDescription:
About Huenx AS

Huenx AS is an AI-first consultancy and product company based in Norway. We deliver software and AI consulting services to clients across Norway and Europe, and we build our own AI-driven products. Our model brings together Norwegian business insight and senior Vietnamese engineering talent — small, highly skilled teams that work effectively with AI to deliver faster than larger organizations.

We run data-intensive projects across multiple industries — property and compliance platforms, industrial AI in oil and gas, and workflow automation. We are hiring for both full-time and hourly engagements.

The role

This is a hands-on senior data engineering role. You build and own the data pipelines and models that power reporting and AI across our client projects — on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, end-to-end. You use AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought. You work directly with our team and our international clients, so clear English communication is essential.Responsibilities

- Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and transformation workflows on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
- Implement a clean medallion architecture (bronze / silver / gold) for layered, reliable data.
- Build and manage transformation models with dbt.
- Build well-structured data models that serve both Power BI reporting and AI/ML consumption.
- Integrate data from diverse internal and external sources across multiple domains.
- Use AI tools (for coding and for daily work) as your default workflow to move fast without sacrificing quality.
- Document pipelines, transformation logic, and data models clearly.
requirements:
- 5–10 years of data engineering experience, with hands-on ownership in production environments.
- Strong hands-on experience with Azure and Microsoft Fabric. Required.
- Strong experience with dbt and medallion architecture. Required.
- Strong SQL and solid data modeling skills (star schema, ETL/ELT design patterns). Python is a plus.
- Familiarity with Power BI and how the data layer drives reporting performance.
- Experience with data pipelines that feed AI and ML models is a strong advantage.
- AI-first: proficient with AI tools for coding and daily work, and able to use them to deliver real, production-grade work. This is a core requirement, not a bonus.
- English: professional working proficiency. You must be able to communicate comfortably and clearly with international clients in English, both written and spoken.
- Able to work Norwegian business hours, which is 12:00 – 21:00 Vietnam time (ICT), Monday to Friday.
benefits:
- AI-first working environment — you'll work with modern AI tooling every day, on both client projects and our own products.
- Remote and flexible, working Norwegian business hours (12:00 – 21:00 Vietnam time) — your mornings are free.
- Salary range: 1,500–3,000 USD (full-time equivalent), depending on experience and engagement type.
- For full-time roles: 13th-month salary, social insurance, company trips, learning and training, and other benefits according to company policies.
- Work on real, complex data problems — not simple pipelines.
- Opportunity to travel to Norway for onsite collaboration, or potentially relocate, depending on performance and project needs.

title: Remote Data Engineer - AI Data Platform Japan (Python)
location: Ha Noi - Da Nang - Ho Chi Minh
reasons:
- 100% remote—work from anywhere with flexible hours
- Claude Code MAX ($200/month) provided from Day 1
- Build pipelines for 8B data points—largest in SEA
jobDescription:
What Makes SalesNow Different

- Data scale: 8B data points, 14M records, 2.3M daily updates (vs. 1M-100M rows at typical companies)
- Data ownership: You build and own Japan's largest corporate intelligence platform (vs. processing someone else's data)
- AI integration: 20+ AI pipelines in production, MCP Server live (vs. "We're planning to use AI someday")
- Dev tools: Claude Code MAX ($200/month), Cursor, CodeRabbit — all company-paid (vs. standard IDE, maybe Copilot)
- Your code's impact: Feeds AI products used by enterprise clients, millisecond latency matters (vs. dashboards no one reads)
- Career trajectory: Build Japan's data infrastructure → architect AI data products → global leverage (vs. same stack forever)
- Remote work: 100% remote, no relocation required (vs. hybrid / office-required)

Why This Role Exists

AI models are commodities now. The cost of running GPT-3.5-equivalent models dropped 280x in two years. Every company has access to the same foundation models. The war moved to data — who owns it, who structures it, who feeds it to AI.

Oracle's Larry Ellison said it plainly on his December 2025 earnings call: "AI models are trained on the same public data, so they're rapidly commoditizing. AI inference on private data will be an even bigger, more valuable business." McKinsey echoes: "By 2030, the AI leaders will be defined not by who trained the biggest model, but by who built the most reliable systems on proprietary data."

SalesNow owns 14 million company records and 8 billion data points — the largest structured corporate intelligence platform in Japan. This data updates 2.3 million records daily, with differential refresh as fast as every 60 seconds. Hiring signals, funding rounds, organizational changes, press releases, job postings — all structured, all real-time, all proprietary.

This data doesn't exist inside any LLM's training set. The only way to access it is through SalesNow. That's the moat.

We need data engineers who can build and scale the pipelines that make this moat wider every day.

What You'll Build

This is not "maintain existing ETL jobs." You're building the data nervous system of Japan's corporate intelligence.

The Scale

- 14 million+ company records across Japan's entire business landscape — from Toyota to a 3-person startup in Okinawa
- 8 billion data points structured and queryable at millisecond speed
- 2.3 million records updated daily — hiring signals, funding rounds, organizational changes, press releases, job postings
- Sub-minute differential refresh — when a company posts a new job or announces funding, SalesNow knows within 60 seconds
- 42+ data sources feeding into a unified schema
- 5 delivery formats: Web app UI / CRM integration (Salesforce, HubSpot) / MCP Server / Data API / Custom AI Agents

AI-Native Development Culture

SalesNow doesn't just "use AI." AI is the operating system of how we build software. What this means for you, concretely:

- Claude Code MAX — Company-paid for every engineer. This is a $200/month tool that most individual developers can't justify. You get it Day 1, fully covered
- Monthly AI tool budget — Tens of thousands of yen per person, on top of Claude Code MAX, for any AI tool you want to try
- CodeRabbit — Automated PR reviews powered by AI. Every pull request gets AI review before human review
- Vibe coding culture — Not just engineers. The CEO, COO, and business teams all write code with AI assistance. When you propose a technical solution, leadership actually understands it
- 20+ AI pipelines in production — X post generation, candidate screening, PR monitoring, behavioral analytics, financial page generation — all running daily in production. This isn't a demo. It's how the company operates
- No "AI committee" or "innovation lab" gatekeeping — You want to try a new approach? Ship it. The decision loop is measured in hours, not quarters

Why this matters for your career: In 3 years, every engineering role will require AI-native development skills. At SalesNow, you build those skills now — not by watching tutorials, but by shipping production AI systems daily.

Before You Apply — Quick Self-CheckPlease confirm the following before submitting your application:

- I have professional experience building data pipelines or data processing systems with Python
- I have professional experience writing SQL queries and working with databases
- I am available for full-time remote work (40 hours/week)

Bonus: Japanese language ability (JLPT N3+) is a strong plus.In Your Cover Letter, Please Include:1. The largest dataset or data pipeline you've worked with — how many records per day, and what did it do?2. What was the most technically challenging problem you solved in your career? (1-2 sentences is fine)3. Which data tools or frameworks have you used? (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Spark, Kafka, Elasticsearch — list any that apply)

- Strong SQL skills — complex queries, window functions, query optimization
- Experience with at least one orchestration tool — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or equivalent

title: Digital Business & Automation Specialist
jobDescription:
We are looking for a hands-on Digital Business & Automation Specialist. This is not a narrow IT admin job, and it is not a pure marketing job. You will work across our websites and e-commerce, Microsoft 365 administration, branding support, product data, and AI-supported automation — building the digital backbone that makes us more professional, more efficient, and easier for customers to work with.

You do not need to be an expert in every tool on day one. You do need to be practical, curious, organized, and able to take ownership. When something is broken, unclear, or manual, we expect you to figure it out, propose a solution, and build it — step by step, without waiting for detailed instructions.

1. E-commerce website & landing pages (~30%)

- Set up, maintain, and improve our e-commerce website for the German market: product pages, categories, technical specifications, downloadable datasheets, and inquiry/order flows
- Keep the shop compatible with 3PL logistics and warehouse fulfillment, coordinating with fulfillment partners
- Build and maintain landing pages for specific products, countries, and campaigns to generate qualified B2B inquiries
- Handle SEO basics, analytics and tracking, inquiry forms, and CRM/email workflow connections
- Run simple A/B tests and continuously improve conversion and usability

2. Automation, AI workflows & internal tools (~25%)

- Automate repetitive office, sales, marketing, and admin processes
- Connect tools such as website forms, email, CRM, spreadsheets, Odoo/ERP, file storage, and reporting systems
- Build simple apps, forms, dashboards, and internal workflows
- Use AI tools to speed up content creation, reporting, and document generation — with human judgment, not blind copy-paste
- Spot automation opportunities and implement them step by step

3. Microsoft 365 & general IT administration (~20%)

- Manage users, email accounts, groups, permissions, and security settings in Microsoft 365
- Support Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and related tools across the company
- Manage domains, website-related accounts, and admin access
- Help standardize digital file structures and internal access rights
- Handle day-to-day IT requests from management and team members

4. Branding, product data & sales material (~20%)

- Improve our professional image across websites, presentations, datasheets, catalogs, email templates, and digital communication
- Help build a consistent corporate design; coordinate with designers, freelancers, or agencies where needed
- Create and maintain product datasheets, descriptions, and technical data in a structured, reusable format
- Support the sales team with documents, templates, and product material — keeping technical accuracy first

5. Reporting, documentation & ongoing improvement (~5%)

- Document what you build so others can use and maintain it
- Report on website performance, inbound inquiries, and automation results
- Suggest and prioritize the next improvements

How we will measure success

No pressure to deliver everything at once — we will grow into this together. Over your first 6–12 months, we would like to see progress like:

- The German e-commerce website takes shape and starts producing B2B inquiries or orders
- Landing pages begin generating qualified inbound inquiries
- Microsoft 365 becomes cleaner and better organized step by step
- Some manual processes get automated, saving real time
- Customer-facing material becomes more consistent and professional
requirements:
What you should bring

You do not need years of professional experience. This role is also open to motivated beginners who can show real drive and practical skills — personal projects, studies, or first work experience all count.

- A real interest in websites, e-commerce, and digital tools — with some first hands-on experience (e.g., WordPress, Shopify, or your own projects)
- Curiosity about AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) and openness to using them in daily work
- Motivation to learn new tools quickly and figure things out on your own
- A sense for structure, tidy layouts, and professional presentation
- Care with details, data, and anything customers will see
- Reliability and open, friendly communication
- Good written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

None of these are required — any of them is a bonus:

- German language skills (we are building a shop for the German market)
- Basic HTML/CSS
- First experience with SEO, Google Analytics, or Search Console
- Microsoft 365 administration, Power Automate, or Power Apps
- Automation tools like Zapier or Make.com
- CRM or Odoo/ERP experience
- Design tools: Canva, Figma, Adobe, PowerPoint
- Interest in technical B2B products — telecom, cabling, or networking
benefits:
- A relaxed, friendly atmosphere in a small international team
- You work from our office, with the flexibility to also work from home
- A short weekly team meeting to align priorities — beyond that, you organize your own work
- Room to try things, learn new tools, and grow with the role

title: Senior React Native Engineer (Full-stack, Node.js)
reasons:
- Competitive salary and benefits
- Comprehensive insurance coverage and allowances
- Generous leave: public + annual + 3 special days
jobDescription:
This is a full-stack feature-delivery role with React Native at its center. You will spend most of your time in the mobile app, but you own features end-to-end. A product requirement drives both the mobile flow and the API contract behind it. A Figma design is one input to that, not the source of the schema. You design the API contract, build it on our existing backend architecture, and integrate it through to the React Native UI.

The app is not a simple UI shell. It includes AI meal scanning, recipe scanning, voice logging, barcode scanning, food diary flows, meal plans, premium subscriptions, and push notifications. It also includes authentication, health-device sync, secure storage, analytics, crash and performance monitoring, and release pipelines for iOS and Android.

We expect this person to work like a senior owner. You should clarify requirements early, design both the mobile flow and the API behind it, write maintainable TypeScript across mobile and backend, test risky paths, and follow production issues through to resolution.

Mobile Product Delivery

- Build and maintain WAO mobile features in React Native, TypeScript, and React Navigation.
- Own key user flows such as meal logging, food diary, meal scanning, voice logging, barcode scanning, meal plans, premium paywalls, profile, onboarding, and reports.
- Translate Figma designs into React Native using the existing design system, theme tokens, shared components, and icon set.
- Keep screens responsive across devices, safe areas, keyboard states, loading states, error states, and permission states.
- Improve app startup, navigation stability, rendering performance, memory use, and image handling.

Native Mobile Capabilities

- Work with camera, microphone, image picker, file upload, WebP conversion, and native barcode detection flows.
- Handle iOS and Android permissions for camera, microphone, notifications, Apple Health, and Health Connect.
- Maintain push and local notification behavior.
- Work with in-app purchases using Apple App Store, Google Play, and backend receipt validation.
- Debug native build, signing, Gradle, CocoaPods, simulator, device, and release issues.

App Data and State

- Manage app state, caching, offline data, and data sync with discipline.
- Keep sensitive data safe and handle auth and network failures gracefully.

Backend API Development

- Design and build the backend GraphQL APIs your features need: schema, resolvers, services, DTO validation, and database access.
- Work from the product requirement, not the screen layout: shape the API contract the mobile feature needs, then build and integrate it end-to-end through to the React Native UI.
- Work on top of the existing architecture and patterns rather than inventing new ones, and keep GraphQL changes backward compatible.
- Build across the backend areas used by mobile: nutrition, tracker, meal scan, recipe scan, voice log, food search, feature flags, authentication, push notifications, and in-app purchases.

Quality and Release

- Write and run unit and end-to-end tests when the change calls for them.
- Add focused tests for risky mobile behavior, payment flows, auth, request retry, and API integration.
- Use crash reporting, performance monitoring, analytics events, and logs to diagnose production issues.
- Support iOS and Android release preparation, store configuration, build checks, and regression testing.
- Review teammates' code and mentor through clear, day-to-day feedback.
requirements:
We are looking for a senior engineer who can own production work end-to-end without waiting for every detail to be assigned.

Experience

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- 4+ years building and maintaining production React Native apps for iOS and Android.
- Strong TypeScript, React, React Native, mobile architecture, debugging, and release experience.
- Experience shipping consumer mobile products with authentication, payments, push notifications, camera, or health-device integrations.
- Solid backend fundamentals in Node.js and TypeScript: API design, validation, authentication, database access, error handling, and tests. Prior NestJS and GraphQL experience is preferred, not mandatory.
- Experience working with product managers, designers, backend engineers, QA, and support teams.
- Working English for technical docs, specs, code review, and cross-team communication.

Must Have

title: Flutter & Native iOS/Android (Fintech)
reasons:
- International fintech & digital banking firm
- Top salary, bonus & stock options

jobDescription:
Role Summary

Vietpay is hiring a Senior Mobile Developer who is Flutter-first but comes from a strong native mobile engineering background. You have built and shipped production applications on iOS or Android at a professional level, and you bring that depth of platform knowledge into your Flutter work. Engineers who have transitioned from native iOS development are strongly preferred — that foundation of understanding how the platform actually works, how builds are configured, how signing and distribution operate, and how native APIs behave, is what separates good Flutter engineers from great ones. You will own the full mobile delivery lifecycle at Vietpay: architecture, feature development, build and release operations, dependency governance, and continuous technical improvement. You take personal accountability for the products you work on and always push toward better engineering.

Key Responsibilities

1) Flutter Development

- Build and maintain production Flutter features using Dart, following Clean Architecture with BLoC or equivalent state management.
- Make sound architectural decisions in the Flutter layer: navigation, state management, platform channels, and native integration.
- Write platform channel integrations when Flutter needs access to native iOS or Android capabilities not covered by existing plugins.
- Maintain Flutter code quality: proper widget decomposition, no business logic in UI, testable BLoCs, and clean dependency injection.
- Stay current with Flutter SDK releases and Dart language updates, proactively adopting improvements that benefit the codebase.

2) Native Mobile Knowledge Applied to Flutter

- Leverage native platform knowledge to debug Flutter issues that surface at the platform layer: build errors, signing failures, native plugin conflicts, and platform-specific rendering behaviour.
- Understand what Flutter abstracts away and what it does not — and know when to drop into native code to solve a problem correctly.
- Apply native architecture instincts — clean layer separation, testability, lifecycle awareness — to Flutter codebase decisions.
- Recognise platform-specific performance characteristics and apply the right fix at the right layer, whether Dart, platform channel, or native.

3) iOS App Setup, Build Configuration, and Distribution

- Own Flutter project setup for iOS: bundle IDs, entitlements, Info.plist configuration, and environment-specific build settings.
- Configure and manage iOS signing: certificates, provisioning profiles, and App ID setup in Apple Developer Portal.
- Set up and maintain App Store Connect: app records, TestFlight distributions, and App Store submissions.
- Manage iOS build tooling and automation: Fastlane lanes for building, signing, testing, and distributing; integration with CI/CD pipelines.
- Configure and manage iOS dependency tooling: CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager as required by Flutter plugins — including version pinning and conflict resolution.
- Manage Flutter flavor and build variant configuration: bundle IDs per environment, build configs, and native bridging for both iOS and Android.

4) Release Management and Operations

- Own the end-to-end release pipeline: from branch to signed build to TestFlight or internal track to store submission.
- Manage App Store review submissions: metadata, screenshots, compliance answers, and resolving reviewer rejections.
- Coordinate with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines that run builds, tests, and distributions automatically on the right triggers.
- Monitor production releases: crash rates, performance regressions, and ANRs via crash reporting and analytics tooling; respond to incidents promptly.
- Maintain changelogs, release notes, and version tracking disciplines across environments.

5) Architecture and Code Quality

- Define and enforce mobile architecture standards across the codebase: folder structure, layer separation, naming conventions, and dependency direction.
- Conduct thorough code reviews focused on correctness, maintainability, security, and alignment with project conventions.
- Write unit tests, widget tests, and integration tests that give genuine confidence in behaviour, not just coverage numbers.
- Identify and address architectural drift before it compounds: refactor proactively rather than building on fragile foundations.
- Document key decisions, patterns, and setup procedures so that the codebase is approachable by any competent engineer, not dependent on tribal knowledge.

6) Dependency and Package Governance

- Own the Flutter dependency graph: audit third-party packages for security, maintenance status, licence compliance, and API stability before adoption.
- Define upgrade policies: keep dependencies current on a schedule, not reactively, and pin versions with documented reasons for exceptions.
- Maintain a managed pub upgrade process: test every upgrade against the full app before merging, document breaking API changes.
- Remove unused dependencies promptly; avoid bloat that inflates binary size or build times.

7) Security and Fintech Compliance

- Apply mobile security best practices: Keychain for credentials, certificate pinning for API communication, jailbreak and root detection, and secure data storage.
- Ensure the app meets financial services compliance requirements: session management, transaction confirmation flows, sensitive data handling, and audit logging of security-relevant actions.
- Follow App Store privacy guidelines rigorously: accurate data usage declarations, permission usage strings, and privacy manifest compliance.
- Never store sensitive financial or user data in plaintext, logs, or insecure storage.

8) Accountability, Ownership, and Continuous Improvement

- Take full ownership of the features and systems you build — not just until the PR merges, but in production, through incidents, and across the full product lifecycle.
- Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and UX friction in the codebase before they become user-facing problems; propose and execute improvements without waiting to be asked.
- Hold yourself to a higher standard than "it works": consider performance, edge cases, accessibility, error states, and long-term maintainability as non-negotiable parts of done.
- Raise concerns early: if a product decision will create technical problems, say so clearly and propose alternatives — not to block delivery, but to protect product quality.
- Continuously learn: follow platform releases, community best practices, and industry patterns in fintech mobile; bring relevant improvements back to the team with a concrete rationale.
- Treat the product as your own: care about the user experience, the crash rate, the App Store rating, and the release cadence as a founder would.
requirements:
Job Requirements

- Must be fluent in English (spoken and written)
- 5+ years of professional mobile development experience with at least one shipped production app.
- Strong background in native mobile development — iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin/Java) — at a professional, production level.
- Solid Flutter and Dart skills with experience delivering a production Flutter application.
- Strong understanding of mobile architecture: Clean Architecture, MVVM, or equivalent applied consistently across a real codebase.

title: Junior Software Test Engineer
jobDescription:
Position Overview

We seek a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Software Test Engineer to join our QA team. In this role, you will ensure the quality and reliability of our software products through manual and automated testing, increasingly augmented by AI-powered QA tools. You will work closely with developers and other stakeholders to identify issues, report defects, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes. This is an excellent opportunity to build a solid foundation in modern, AI-assisted software quality assurance and grow your technical skills.

- Identify and document software defects, using AI tools to help generate clear, detailed bug reports that are then imported into Azure DevOps for tracking.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and methodologies.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Personal Attributes

- Self-motivated and a proactive fast learner, with the ability to quickly grasp new technologies and AI tools.
- A collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
- A positive thinker with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility.
