You will own outcomes, not tickets. Your work is measured against two hard targets:

Cost-to-Income Ratio (CIR) improvement — automating high-cost manual workflows (document processing, credit operations, AML/ops review, RM support) so the bank does more with the same headcount. Or:Revenue growth through personalization — building AI systems that lift products-per-customer, card and lending penetration, CASA, and campaign conversion by delivering the right offer to the right customer at the right time.You embed with a division, learn its workflow better than it knows itself, build the agent or pipeline that removes the cost or unlocks the revenue, and put it into production. Then you do it again.

1. Forward-Deployed DeliveryEmbed directly with a business division (Retail, SME, Risk, Operations, AML) — sit with the operators, map the workflow end-to-end, and identify where AI removes cost or creates revenue.Own the full lifecycle of each solution: problem framing, architecture, data pipeline, build, deployment, integration with core banking, and the business result. You are accountable for the metric, not just the model.Ship fast and iterate in production. We measure success in deployed systems and basis points of CIR, not slide decks.

Banking-grade means measurable, monitored, and safe by default.Own deployment, model serving, monitoring, and retraining. Meet SLAs. Partner with IT and infra to integrate cleanly with core banking systems (T24, Way4, LOS, OMNI) and internal platforms.

5. Squad LeadershipSet the engineering bar. Mentor junior squad members and pull business stakeholders along with you — translating workflow pain into shipped systems and shipped systems into business value.

jobDescription:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to strengthen our platform engineering team. In this role you will design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure on Azure or GCP, drive CI/CD automation, and embed GitOps practices that let product teams ship with confidence. You will work closely with infrastructure, security, and application teams — translating complex technical solutions into measurable business outcomes while raising the DevOps bar across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Cloud

- Design, develop, and manage cloud infrastructure using an IaC tool such as Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation.
- Administer and harden Linux servers for DevOps and application workloads, ensuring security and operational stability.
- Manage containerized workloads with Kubernetes and Docker, including cluster configuration, scaling, and lifecycle management.

CI/CD & Automation

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using one or more tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
- Implement GitOps workflows using a tool such as FluxCD with Helm charts to enable automated, declarative delivery.
- Develop automation scripts in Bash and/or Python to drive operational efficiency and environment management.

Observability & Reliability

- Operate and optimize a monitoring and observability stack — such as Grafana/Prometheus, ELK/OpenSearch, Dynatrace, or Datadog.
- Implement and support robust logging, alerting, and incident response strategies.

Collaboration & Leadership

- Collaborate cross-functionally with infrastructure, security, and other internal teams to deliver reliable, scalable services.
- Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and customers, translating technical solutions into business value.
- Lead or contribute to technical decision-making, best practice definition, and DevOps knowledge sharing within the team.

What Seniority Means in This Role

We are not just looking for someone who can execute tasks — we expect a Senior DevOps Engineer to operate with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, and technical leadership. Here is what that looks like day-to-day:

Ownership & Autonomy

- You take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure domains — from design through delivery and ongoing operations — without needing close supervision.
- You proactively identify gaps in reliability, security, or scalability and drive improvements rather than waiting to be assigned work.

Technical Depth & Judgement

- You make sound architectural decisions independently, weighing trade-offs between tooling choices, cost, maintainability, and risk.
- You are the go-to person for complex infrastructure problems, debugging production incidents, and designing resilient systems.
- You stay current with the DevOps ecosystem and can evaluate new tools or practices critically before adopting them.

Influence & Mentorship

- You actively raise the team’s technical bar — through code reviews, pairing sessions, internal workshops, or written documentation.
- You mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing constructive feedback and helping them grow into independent contributors.
- You contribute to defining team standards, best practices, and DevOps culture within the engineering organization.

Stakeholder Communication

- You communicate infrastructure decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders.
- You translate platform work into business value — uptime, velocity, cost savings — and advocate for platform investment when needed.
requirements:
Must Have

Experience

- 5–7 years of professional experience in a DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering role.
- Professional-level hands-on experience with Azure or GCP (deep expertise in one is required).

Infrastructure as Code

- Proficiency in at least one IaC tool: Terraform (preferred), Bicep, or CloudFormation.
- Strong grasp of IaC best practices: state management, module design, drift detection, and GitOps workflows.

CI/CD & GitOps

- Hands-on experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
- Experience with GitOps tooling — FluxCD preferred — using Helm charts for declarative delivery.
- Familiarity with version control systems: Git or Azure DevOps Git.

Platform & Systems

- Strong Linux system administration and troubleshooting experience.
- Skilled in scripting and automation using Bash and/or Python.
- Experience managing containerized workloads on Kubernetes and/or Docker.

title: AI-Integrated Cad Automation Engineer
company: Công ty TNHH Peregrine Management Việt Nam

jobDescription:
We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking AI-Integrated CAD Automation Engineer to serve as the critical link between our mechanical design environment and our emerging AI-driven design intelligence platform. In this role, you will apply deep expertise in Autodesk Inventor and Vault PDM to develop automated workflows that extract, structure, and publish design data for consumption by AI and machine learning systems. Working alongside an AI Engineer and a Data Pipeline Engineer, your contributions will directly reduce the engineering hours required to configure grinding machines and will enable intelligent part reuse and standardization across our machine platforms.

This is a pioneering role at the intersection of precision mechanical design and modern AI technology. Your work will help build one of the first AI-assisted mechanical design ecosystems in our industry, with high visibility and direct impact on how we design, configure, and deliver products to our customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1.  CAD Design & 3D Modeling

- Create and maintain parametric 3D models and 2D drawings of mechanical components, sub-assemblies, and primary machine assemblies using Autodesk Inventor.
- Develop and enforce CAD standards, naming conventions, and model structure guidelines that support downstream AI data processing.
- Manage design data within Autodesk Vault PDM, ensuring structured metadata, revision control, and full component traceability.
- Maintain a well-organized part library with clear relationships between components, sub-assemblies, and machine-level assemblies.

2.  iLogic Automation Development

- Author and maintain iLogic rules and scripts within Autodesk Inventor to automate design workflows, parameter-driven modeling, and data extraction.
- Develop automated export routines using iLogic that extract part geometry metadata, assembly structures, and BOM data in XML and Markdown formats.
- Build configuration-driven design scripts that reduce manual effort when specifying or adapting machine layouts from existing component libraries.
- Continuously improve and refactor iLogic scripts based on feedback from AI data pipeline validation results.

3.  Design Data Export & AI Integration

- Design and implement structured export schemas capturing part metadata, assembly hierarchies, and full Bill of Materials (BOM) data in XML and Markdown formats.
- Collaborate with the AI Engineer and Data Pipeline Engineer to define data formats compatible with vector database and graph database ingestion pipelines.
- Map hierarchical relationships between individual parts, sub-assemblies, and primary machine assemblies to support construction of a CAD knowledge graph.
- Validate exported data for completeness, consistency, and AI readiness — iterating on schemas based on pipeline and model feedback.
- Develop and maintain documentation of all export schemas, data dictionaries, and field definitions for use by the broader AI team.

4.  Design Intelligence & Part Reuse

- Develop tools and structured processes within Inventor and Vault to identify and flag opportunities for part reuse and component standardization across machine platforms.
- Support AI-driven analysis of the part library by ensuring exported data clearly communicates part function, geometry characteristics, and interchangeability attributes.
- Contribute to configuration intelligence initiatives that reduce the engineering time required to specify, quote, and configure a grinding machine from existing assemblies.
- Track and report on part reuse metrics, helping quantify the business value of the AI design automation program.

5.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

- Work closely with the AI Engineer and Data Pipeline Engineer in regular sprint cycles to refine data schemas, resolve pipeline issues, and incorporate AI feedback into design modeling practices.
- Participate in design reviews and platform standardization initiatives, contributing the CAD and engineering perspective to AI-driven decisions.
- Produce clear, maintainable documentation of all automation scripts, data export workflows, and schema designs to ensure long-term supportability and knowledge transfer.
- Act as an internal subject matter expert on Autodesk Inventor and Vault capabilities, advising the team on what is feasible for automation and data extraction.
requirements:
Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Autodesk Inventor for parametric 3D solid modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
- Demonstrated experience with Autodesk Vault PDM for design data management, revision control, and BOM structuring.
- Experience developing iLogic rules or scripts (or equivalent Inventor API automation) for design workflow automation.
- Strong working knowledge of XML data structures and the ability to design and validate custom XML schemas.
- Solid understanding of mechanical assembly hierarchies, multi-level BOMs, and engineering change management processes.
- Ability to collaborate effectively in a small, cross-disciplinary team alongside software and AI engineers.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to document technical processes clearly for non-CAD audiences.

Preferred

- Experience exporting structured design data from a CAD or PLM environment for consumption by software systems, databases, or analytical tools.
- Familiarity with graph data concepts and an ability to think about parts and assemblies as nodes and relationships in a knowledge graph.
- Exposure to AI or machine learning concepts — no programming expertise required, but curiosity and willingness to learn is essential.
- Experience in the industrial machinery, precision machining, or grinding / finishing equipment industry.
- Familiarity with Markdown as a documentation format.
- Experience with Autodesk Inventor and Vault Developer SDK beyond standard iLogic rules.

HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS

In this role, success will be evaluated across several dimensions as the program matures:

- Completeness and quality of CAD data exports consumed by the AI pipeline without manual correction.
- Reduction in engineering hours required to configure a grinding machine from the existing component library.
- Growth in the percentage of new machine designs that reuse existing parts rather than introducing new unique components.
- Adoption and reliability of iLogic automation scripts across the design team.
- Quality and coverage of schema documentation produced for the AI and data engineering teams.

WHY THIS ROLE

This position sits at the frontier of mechanical design and artificial intelligence — a rare opportunity for a design engineer who wants to do more than model parts. You will be a founding contributor to an AI-assisted design system, working within a focused team where your contributions shape the direction of the program. You will grow your skill set into data engineering, AI collaboration, and automation development while remaining grounded in the mechanical design discipline you already know. Your work will have a lasting impact on how our machines are designed, configured, and brought to market.

Giá trị cốt lõi: ERP là hệ thống xương sống quản trị toàn bộ hoạt động cốt lõi của mọi doanh nghiệp (Sản xuất, Kế toán, Kho vận...). Kiến thức chuyên môn và tư duy hệ thống tích lũy tại Akira sẽ mang lại giá trị dài hạn, là bệ phóng vững chắc cho sự nghiệp của bạn ở bất kỳ ngành nghề nào.
- Lộ trình và định hướng phát triển: Tại AKIRA, bạn không chỉ tích lũy kinh nghiệm lập trình thuần túy mà còn được nâng cao chuyên môn sâu trong lĩnh vực ERP. Định hướng tương lai, công ty tạo điều kiện tối đa để bạn phát triển trở thành Bridge SE (Kỹ sư cầu nối) hoặc ERP System Engineer / Project Manager trong môi trường chuyên nghiệp, 100% nhân sự có thể sử dụng tiếng Nhật và các sếp người Nhật có nhiều kinh nghiệm.

QUYỀN LỢI

- Mức lương: Thỏa thuận phù hợp với năng lực (chưa bao gồm thưởng dự án, thưởng lễ Tết, các khoản thưởng khác,..)
- Thu nhập: 13 tháng lương/năm + thưởng dự án, thưởng Tết,…
- Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp (Công ty Nhật 100%), phát huy tối đa năng lực Nhật ngữ, được hỗ trợ phát huy về công nghệ, phát triển công việc tối đa bởi các leader và sếp người Nhật.
- Cơ hội để phát triển thành BrSE (kỹ sư cầu nối), học hỏi quy trình kỹ thuật và đóng dấu ấn cá nhân rõ nét;
- Nghỉ thứ 7, Chủ Nhật + Nghỉ phép theo Quy định của Pháp luật hiện hành.
- Chế độ bảo hiểm: Được tham gia BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo Quy định của Pháp luật hiện hành và quy định công ty
- Chương trình chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn diện với gói Bảo hiểm sức khỏe PVI cho toàn bộ nhân viên
- Khám sức khỏe định kỳ 1 năm/lần;

title: Business Analyst (IT Projects)
jobDescription:
Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một Business Analyst năng động để tham gia phát triển các dự án IT phục vụ hệ sinh thái sản phẩm của khách hàng và của chính công ty. Bạn sẽ là cầu nối giữa các stakeholder kinh doanh (advertisers, app developers, device manufacturers) và đội ngũ kỹ thuật, đảm bảo các sản phẩm được xây dựng đúng nhu cầu thị trường, đúng kỹ thuật và đúng tiến độ.

Trách nhiệm chính

- Thu thập, phân tích và làm rõ yêu cầu (requirements) từ các stakeholder nội bộ và đối tác (manufacturers, carriers, advertisers).
- Viết tài liệu nghiệp vụ: BRD, FRD, SRS, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria.
- Vẽ và mô hình hóa quy trình nghiệp vụ bằng BPMN, UML, flowchart, wireframe, mockup.
- Phối hợp với Product Manager để xây dựng product backlog, ưu tiên tính năng theo giá trị kinh doanh.
- Làm việc trực tiếp với đội ngũ Dev, QA, Designer trong các sprint Agile/Scrum để đảm bảo hiểu đúng yêu cầu.
- Phân tích dữ liệu (campaign performance, user behavior, traffic, monetization metrics) để đề xuất cải tiến sản phẩm.
- Tham gia UAT, demo sản phẩm với khách hàng, hỗ trợ giải đáp các vấn đề nghiệp vụ.
requirements:
Yêu cầu bắt buộc

- 1 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Business Analyst trong môi trường phát triển phần mềm/IT.
- Thành thạo các kỹ thuật phân tích nghiệp vụ: BRD/SRS, user story, BPMN, UML, wireframing (Figma/Axure/Balsamiq).
- Kinh nghiệm làm việc theo mô hình Agile/Scrum, sử dụng Jira, Confluence.
- Kỹ năng SQL cơ bản đến trung cấp để truy vấn và phân tích dữ liệu.
- Giao tiếp tiếng Anh tốt (đọc – viết – nói) vì làm việc với đối tác quốc tế.
- Tư duy logic, khả năng phân tích vấn đề và trình bày giải pháp rõ ràng.
- Kỹ năng giao tiếp, thuyết trình và làm việc nhóm đa văn hóa.

Ưu tiên (Nice-to-have)

- Hiểu biết về API, REST, JSON, tích hợp hệ thống.
- Kinh nghiệm với các công cụ BI/analytics (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Google Analytics).
- Chứng chỉ IIBA (ECBA/CCBA/CBAP) hoặc PMI-PBA là một lợi thế.
- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với device manufacturers, app developers hoặc các nền tảng publisher.
benefits:
- Mức lương cạnh tranh, thỏa thuận theo năng lực (negotiable).
- Môi trường làm việc đa văn hóa, quốc tế.
- Cơ hội tham gia các dự án quy mô toàn cầu với các đối tác công nghệ lớn.
- Bảo hiểm sức khỏe, chế độ nghỉ phép theo quy định.

- Lộ trình thăng tiến rõ ràng lên Senior BA / Product Owner.

title: Senior DevOps/ SRE Engineer (AWS/GCP)
reasons:

- Work with big-name global clients
- AI-first: Work with AI at the core
jobDescription:
About the Role

- Gradion is expanding its SRE team for the a client with a long-term managed services contract running through 2028. You will be part of a global, follow-the-sun SRE function, responsible for platform stability, cloud infrastructure, and incident response.
- This role suits engineers who are technically solid, self-directed, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, internationally distributed environment. You will go through a structured onboarding alongside an internal SRE team before taking on independent operational responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

- Own platform availability: monitor, triage, and resolve incidents within defined SLA windows
- Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP - provisioning, scaling, and day-to-day operations
- Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows
- Operate observability systems: monitoring, logging, and alerting at production scale
- Participate in on-call rotation as part of the global follow-the-sun coverage model
- Contribute to infrastructure automation, scripting, and internal tooling
- Write clear post-incident reviews and contribute to the monthly operational report
- Collaborate closely with engineering teams across multiple time zones
- Configure, deploy, and manage AI tooling and MCP servers in production environments
requirements:
- 4+ years in a DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering role within an international team
- Solid Kubernetes knowledge - cluster operations, troubleshooting, and configuration
- Hands-on cloud experience with AWS and/or GCP
- Good understanding of networking fundamentals - DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPC
- Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
- Experience with CI/CD tools and GitOps-based delivery
- Working knowledge of monitoring and observability systems (Prometheus, ELK, or equivalent)
- Good English - daily communication with European stakeholders is a core requirement
- Self-directed and proactive - you ask the right questions and drive issues to resolution without waiting to be told

Nice to Have:

- Exposure to AI enablement workflows or LLM infrastructure
- Background supporting eCommerce or SaaS platforms
- Familiarity with the Frontastic / commercetools Frontend ecosystem

As a forward-thinking consultancy, we go beyond traditional engineering, combining technical excellence with a strategic mindset to deliver transformative solutions for ambitious businesses.

💰 Competitive Compensation - We believe great talent deserves great rewards. Expect an attractive salary, performance-based bonuses, and a benefits package that reflects your impact. We value talent over salary budgets - exceptional contributions deserve exceptional rewards.

title: IT Transformation Director (ERP, Enterprise Architect)
jobDescription:
Kusto Home JSC, a Vietnam-based premium residential and mixed-use real estate developer (part of Kusto Group), is recruiting an IT Transformation Director to lead a multi-year digital transformation of the Group's technology, data, and information security platform.

This is a green-field senior leadership role. The successful candidate will design and deliver the IT and digital strategy for a developer growing from USD 100 million in current assets to USD 500 million in revenue across an active project pipeline over the next five years. They will modernise core enterprise systems, embed cybersecurity and data protection, build a small high-quality in-house team supported by external partners, and position the Group's technology platform to scale with the business — without scaling headcount proportionally.

The role reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer with a dotted line to the Deputy CEO Corporate. It is a member of the senior leadership team and will be the Group's senior representative on all technology, data, and information security matters with shareholders and the Board.

The mission — first 12 months

- Conduct a structured IT and digital maturity assessment within the first 30 days and present a 2-year roadmap to the CEO and Board.
- Select, implement, and stabilise an integrated ERP platform (financial, project cost control, treasury, procurement) — likely Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, or comparable, with full multi-entity consolidation.
- Deploy a modern CRM and sales management platform appropriate to Vietnamese real estate sales operations (multi-channel lead capture, sales agent workflow, customer payment scheduling, contract management).
- Standardise project management software across all active projects (cost, schedule, design coordination, contractor management).
- Build and embed the Company's information security and data protection framework, fully compliant with Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Decree 13/2023 and aligned with international standards (ISO 27001 direction).
- Define and enforce IT general controls supporting Internal Audit and the Group's governance framework — access management, change management, segregation of duties, backup and recovery, vendor security.
- Identify and deploy practical AI and automation use cases that meaningfully reduce administrative burden (sales operations, document management, finance close, customer service, executive reporting).
- Establish a vendor management framework that gets the Group out of dependence on individual ad-hoc IT vendors and into a small set of accountable strategic partners.
- Build a lean in-house team of 2-3 high-quality professionals and a clearly governed external partner panel.

Ongoing responsibilities

Strategy and architecture

- Own the Group's IT and digital strategy, architecture, and 2-year capital and operating budget.
- Make build-vs-buy decisions, vendor selection decisions, and architecture decisions with the rigour expected at Group-leadership level.
- Represent the IT and digital agenda to the Board, shareholders, and external auditors.

Enterprise systems

- Own the full lifecycle of ERP, CRM, project management, HR, and supporting business systems — selection, implementation, change management, ongoing operation, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure full system integration so finance, sales, project delivery, and corporate functions operate from one consistent data set.
- Define and own master data governance across all entities.

Information security and data protection

- Own end-to-end information security: identity and access management, endpoint security, network and infrastructure security, data loss prevention, incident response.
- Lead Decree 13/2023 personal data protection compliance — including data mapping, consent management, data subject rights handling, cross-border data transfer compliance, and breach notification readiness.
- Build, test, and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans for critical systems.
- Serve as the primary point for cyber-incident response and external regulator engagement on data matters.

AI, automation, and digital initiatives

- Identify, prioritise, and deliver practical AI and automation use cases with measurable business impact — sales operations, customer experience, document and contract automation, finance and HR operations, executive analytics.
- Embed a culture of process improvement and digital efficiency across the leadership team.
- Maintain a clear-eyed view on hype-versus-value and focus the Group's investment on initiatives that deliver.

Governance and team

- Build and lead a lean in-house team — initially 2 people — with a clear deputy / Successor and visible development paths under the Group's Senior Leadership Succession Mandate.
- Manage external partners (ERP implementation partner, cybersecurity managed service provider, software vendors, infrastructure providers) under a clear vendor management framework.
- Own the IT operating and capital budget and report against it quarterly to the CEO and the Board.
- Coordinate closely with the Internal Audit function on IT general controls testing and remediation.
requirements:
- Minimum 15 years of IT leadership experience, including at least 5 years in Director, VP, CIO, or equivalent roles.
- Proven experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation programs from strategy through implementation.
- Strong ERP implementation experience (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar) in multi-entity environments.
- Experience with CRM platforms and enterprise business systems.
- Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, information security frameworks, and data protection compliance.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. Master's degree is an advantage.
- Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred

- Experience in real estate, property management, hospitality, retail, or other project-driven industries.
- Experience building IT functions and transforming fragmented IT environments.
- Practical experience in AI and workflow automation initiatives.
- Professional certifications such as PMP, CISSP, CISM, ITIL, or TOGAF are advantageous.
benefits:

- Healthcare plan for you and your 01 family member
- 15 days of fully paid leave a year
- Other benefits: Outing trip, Tet gift, Mid-autumn gift, parties….
- Training and career evolution opportunities
- An international standard working environment
- Trusting and empowering our employees

title: Principal Backend Engineer (AWS, TypeScript, DynamoDB)
reasons:

jobDescription:
About the role

Strong written and verbal English is a hard requirement for this role — please read on with that in mind.

You will own the backend that sits at the center of our business — the system of record for nearly everything the company does. This is the kind of role most engineers never get a shot at: a mature, high-throughput platform built on architectural choices that reward careful engineering, with real autonomy and consequential decisions to make. You are inheriting it, not building it from scratch, and you will be responsible for keeping it correct and fast while extending it.

You will initially work under the platform architect, with the explicit goal of growing into the architect role yourself. The work is hands-on and deeply technical, and you operate with a high degree of autonomy from day one.

What you'll work with

- AWS AppSync (GraphQL) — a single annotated schema compiled into multiple role-scoped APIs, backed by a large library of VTL resolvers and pipeline functions assembled through a custom build system.
- Amazon DynamoDB — single-table design with composite (PK/SK) keys, multiple GSIs, Streams, TTL, and PITR. The primary source of truth for the platform.
- AWS Lambda (TypeScript/Node.js) — many functions in an Nx monorepo, bundled with esbuild: API resolvers, queue consumers, stream processors, and Step Function tasks.
- AWS Step Functions — orchestration of multi-step workflows (order fulfillment, settlement/payout, lifecycle state machines).
- Event-driven processing — DynamoDB Streams, SQS, and Kinesis.
- Secondary data systems — Aurora MySQL, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, and Turbopuffer (vector/semantic search).
- Third-party integrations — Stripe, Pusher, Etsy, Amazon Cognito, and Sentry.
- Infrastructure as Code — Terraform/OpenTofu managing dev, test, and production.
- Testing — Jest (unit/integration) and Vitest end-to-end suites running against live AppSync APIs.

Responsibilities

- Work under the platform architect initially, with a clear path to taking on the architect role yourself as you build context and trust.
- Own the architecture, evolution, and reliability of the core backend repository and several related backend services — including a separate asset-generation service for image, PDF, and font pipelines.
- Design and extend DynamoDB access patterns — keys, indexes, and item layouts — treating schema and key-design changes as high-stakes, well-reasoned decisions.
- Build and maintain GraphQL APIs and their resolver pipelines, including VTL mapping logic and the supporting Lambda functions.
- Design event-driven and orchestrated workflows (Streams, SQS, Step Functions) that are idempotent, observable, and resilient to partial failure.
- Manage infrastructure through Terraform/OpenTofu; own safe, repeatable deployments across environments.
- Diagnose production issues to root cause — not symptoms — across the data, API, and integration layers.
- As the backend team grows, take on day-to-day technical leadership of less experienced engineers — mentorship, code review, and helping them ramp up on the platform's complexity.
- Uphold and extend a strong engineering documentation culture (architecture decisions, patterns, and gotchas are written down, not held in one person's head).
requirements:
Required qualifications

- 10+ years of professional backend engineering experience (15+ preferred), with a substantial portion spent owning production systems at scale.
- Deep, hands-on AWS experience, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure managed with Terraform/OpenTofu.
- Strong NoSQL data-modeling expertise — direct experience designing single-table or composite-key models and the access patterns that ride on them, with a real understanding of the trade-offs involved.
- Production TypeScript/Node.js proficiency.
- Strong written and verbal English, including the ability to produce clear documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders in other time zones.
- A demonstrated track record of full ownership: making sound architectural calls independently and being accountable for the result.

Strongly preferred

- AWS AppSync and GraphQL resolver experience (VTL a strong plus).
- Event-driven architecture and workflow orchestration (Step Functions, Streams, queues).
- Experience operating high-throughput, low-latency systems where data correctness is non-negotiable.
- Working experience with relational databases, search databases, and vector databases / embeddings.
- Image processing and color management for print (Sharp/ImageMagick, ICC profiles, RGB→CMYK).
- PDF internals, vector/SVG manipulation, and font engineering (pdf-lib, SVGO, fontTools/FontForge).
- Headless browser rendering (Puppeteer/Chromium) for high-fidelity output.
- Hands-on experience with AI agent orchestration, multi-agent workflows, and validation strategies — using harnesses like Claude Code or Pi to drive real engineering work, not just chat-style assistance.
benefits:
The opportunity

If you take pride in measuring twice and cutting once, reasoning to root cause, and writing down what you learn, this is the kind of system worth building a career around.

Why Join Corjl

- A high-impact role with real ownership over the core platform behind a growing product used by creators worldwide.
- A team that invests in great engineering — this is a leadership role, not a support role.
- Collaborative, engineering-driven environment based in Ho Chi Minh City.

How to Apply:

- Please submit your CV and links to recent work demonstrating your backend engineering capabilities. We are most interested in seeing your engineering thinking — include examples that show how you reasoned about a hard architectural problem, modeled data, and ensured correctness and reliability at scale.
- Applications without relevant work samples or a clear account of systems you have owned will not be considered.

title: Senior Backend Dev ( AWS, JavaScript, NodeJS, GraphQL)
reasons:
- Competitive salary depend on your performance
- Working with young and passion employee
- Green and spacious office
jobDescription:
About the role

Strong written and verbal English is a hard requirement for this role — please read on with that in mind.

You’ll be a core contributor on the backend that sits at the center of our business — the system of record for nearly everything the company does. It’s a mature, high-throughput platform, and you’re joining a small team that owns it, working alongside the platform architect and a Principal Engineer. The work is hands-on and deeply technical, and you’ll be trusted with real components and features from the start.

This is a strong role for an experienced engineer who wants to do real work on a real system: meaningful ownership over what you ship, exposure to architectural decisions, and a clear path to expanding scope as you build context and earn trust.

What you’ll work with

- AWS AppSync (GraphQL) — a single annotated schema compiled into multiple role-scoped APIs, backed by a large library of VTL resolvers and pipeline functions assembled through a custom build system.
- Amazon DynamoDB — single-table design with composite (PK/SK) keys, multiple GSIs, Streams, TTL, and PITR. The primary source of truth for the platform.
- AWS Lambda (TypeScript/Node.js) — many functions in an Nx monorepo, bundled with esbuild: API resolvers, queue consumers, stream processors, and Step Function tasks.
- AWS Step Functions — orchestration of multi-step workflows (order fulfillment, settlement/payout, lifecycle state machines).
- Event-driven processing — DynamoDB Streams, SQS, and Kinesis.
- Secondary data systems — Aurora MySQL, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, and Turbopuffer (vector/semantic search).
- Third-party integrations — Stripe, Pusher, Etsy, Amazon Cognito, and Sentry.
- Infrastructure as Code — Terraform/OpenTofu managing dev, test, and production.
- Testing — Jest (unit/integration) and Vitest end-to-end suites running against live AppSync APIs.

Responsibilities

- Build, extend, and maintain features across the core backend repository and related backend services.
- Implement GraphQL APIs and their resolver pipelines, including VTL mapping logic and the supporting Lambda functions.
- Work with the existing DynamoDB access patterns and indexes — extending them carefully and flagging when a change has broader implications.
- Build event-driven and orchestrated workflows (Streams, SQS, Step Functions) that are idempotent, observable, and resilient to partial failure.
- Diagnose production issues across the data, API, and integration layers — reasoning to root cause, not symptoms.
- Make infrastructure changes through Terraform/OpenTofu when your work requires them.
- Participate in code review and design discussions; raise alternatives and trade-offs rather than just executing.
- Contribute to and uphold the team’s documentation culture (architecture decisions, patterns, and gotchas get written down).
requirements:
Required qualifications

- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience (7+ preferred), with significant time in production systems on AWS.
- Hands-on AWS experience across core serverless and data services — Lambda, DynamoDB, IAM, SQS, S3, CloudWatch — and comfort working with infrastructure managed by Terraform/OpenTofu.
- Working knowledge of DynamoDB and NoSQL data modeling — composite keys, GSIs, access patterns — with an understanding of why those choices matter at scale.
- Production TypeScript/Node.js proficiency.
- Strong written and verbal English, including the ability to produce clear documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders in other time zones.
- A track record of shipping reliable production code and taking responsibility for the work you put your name on.

Strongly preferred

- AWS AppSync and GraphQL resolver experience (VTL a plus).
- Event-driven architecture and workflow orchestration (Step Functions, Streams, queues).
- Experience operating systems where data correctness and reliability matter — payments, ordering, anything money-touching.
- Working experience with relational databases, search databases, or vector databases / embeddings.
- Image processing and color management for print (Sharp/ImageMagick, ICC profiles, RGB→CMYK).
- PDF internals, vector/SVG manipulation, or font engineering (pdf-lib, SVGO, fontTools/FontForge).
- Headless browser rendering (Puppeteer/Chromium) for high-fidelity output.
- Hands-on experience with AI agent orchestration, multi-agent workflows, and validation strategies — using harnesses like Claude Code or Pi to drive real engineering work, not just chat-style assistance.
benefits:
A chance to do serious engineering on a serious system, alongside people who care about getting it right and care about helping you grow. If you sweat the details, debug to root cause, and want to keep getting better at this, it’s a good place to do that.

Why Join Corjl

- A high-impact role with real ownership over the core platform behind a growing product used by creators worldwide.
- Collaborative, engineering-driven environment based in Ho Chi Minh City.
- Competitive salary and benefits commensurate with experience.

How to Apply:

- Please submit your CV and links to recent work demonstrating your backend engineering capabilities. We are most interested in seeing your engineering thinking — include examples that show how you reasoned about a hard architectural problem, modeled data, and ensured correctness and reliability at scale.
- Applications without relevant work samples or a clear account of systems you have owned will not be considered.

jobDescription:
Role summary

The Mobile Gamification UI/UX Designer (Fintech) leads the design of high retention mobile experiences for Vietpay. You will translate product goals into engaging user journeys using point systems, missions, rewards, and clear progress feedback, supported by strong narrative and microcopy. This is a hands on role that requires expert Figma execution, strong mobile interaction design, and close collaboration with engineering to ship production quality experiences.

Key responsibilities

1) Gamification and engagement design

• Own the gamification framework across onboarding, activation, and daily usage loops, aligned with measurable business outcomes.

• Design and document mechanics such as points, XP, levels, missions, streaks, badges, challenges, unlocks, and reward redemption flows.

• Create progression and feedback systems that motivate users to complete financial tasks, without confusing users or reducing trust.

• Define anti abuse rules and edge cases for point earning and reward logic, in partnership with product, risk, and engineering teams.

• Ensure gamification is ethical and transparent, avoiding dark patterns and protecting the integrity of a financial product.

2) Story and narrative design

• Develop a simple narrative layer that makes complex fintech tasks feel clear, motivating, and approachable.

• Design mission structures and achievement messaging that guide users to the next best action.

• Partner with product and marketing on tone, microcopy direction, and achievement stories that match the Vietpay brand.

3) Mobile UI and UX ownership

• Lead end to end UX from user flows and wireframes to high fidelity UI, interaction states, and clickable prototypes.

• Design mobile first experiences for Android and iOS, including onboarding, dashboard, tasks, rewards, and account and security related screens.

• Create and maintain a scalable component library and design system in Figma, including gamification components and states.

• Produce developer ready specs, including layout rules, responsive behavior, empty states, error states, and accessibility considerations.

4) Cross functional delivery with engineering

• Work closely with engineers, QA, and product managers to plan, scope, and deliver features on schedule.

• Provide detailed handoff materials, including annotations, interaction rules, and acceptance criteria for UI behavior.

• Review builds, provide structured feedback, and ensure the shipped UI matches intended design and quality.

5) Web and website design support

• Support related web experiences when needed, including landing pages, product marketing flows, and partner portals.

• Ensure consistent brand expression and design language across mobile and web.

6) Testing, iteration, and metrics driven improvement

• Collaborate on usability testing and rapid iteration cycles to validate designs before and after release.

• Partner with product and analytics to monitor activation, retention, feature adoption, and reward engagement, then iterate based on data.

• Maintain documentation of design decisions, edge cases, and learnings to scale the system over time.

• 5+ years of UI and UX design experience, with a strong portfolio of shipped mobile apps.

• Proven experience designing gamification systems such as point based rewards, progression, missions, streaks, and redemption journeys.

• Expert in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, libraries, and prototyping.

• Strong collaboration experience with software engineering teams, including agile delivery and clear design handoff.

• Excellent English communication skills, spoken and written. Vietnamese is strongly preferred.

• Strong mobile interaction design skills for Android and iOS, including edge cases, error states, and accessibility.

• Experience with motion design and micro interactions for mobile UI.

• Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation workflows, including A and B testing.

• Experience contributing to or owning a design system across mobile and web.

jobDescription:
YOU

You want to be an important member of a strong team of other makers who take pride in their work and support each other. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will join the AI-Powered Takeoff Team in Vietnam, collaborating closely with U.S. stakeholders and coordinating with external vendors to build an AI-driven product that transforms technical drawings (PDFs, CAD files, and blueprints) into actionable data, directly improving product performance and business efficiency. That’s year one. If career growth is important to you, we not only know how to help you with that, it’s what we love to do:

PROJECT DESCRIPTION

AI-Powered Takeoff is an intelligent construction TakeOff platform designed to automate material quantity takeoffs from architectural and engineering drawings. By leveraging computer vision, machine learning, and the system extracts, measures, and categorizes building components directly from digital blueprints PDF, significantly reducing manual effort, errors, and turnaround time.

The objective of AI-Powered Takeoff is to:

- Automate quantity detection from drawings
- Assist with measurements (length, area, count, volume)
- Organize extracted quantities in structured formats
- Support revision comparison
- Reduce manual tracing effort

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

At Simpson Strong-Tie we value the individual, and the creativity that individuals can bring to the workplace. You join this company for a career, not a job!

- You will join the AI Engineering team within an innovative manufacturing and construction technology environment, collaborating closely with the US team to design and develop AI services that enhance product performance and deliver measurable business impact.
- You thrive in a cross-functional environment, working closely with product managers, AI engineers, subject matter experts (SMEs), data analysts, product engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end machine learning pipelines for automated vision processing
- Build systems for symbol detection, drawing interpretation, floor plan parsing, and quantity extraction from construction documents (PDFs, CAD exports, blueprints).
- Develop and fine-tune object detection and segmentation models to identify construction elements (walls, doors, windows, fixtures, framing, hardware components, etc.).
- Implement OCR/YOLO and document layout analysis pipelines to extract annotations, dimensions, and labels from technical drawings.
- Apply advanced ML techniques including transformer-based vision models and multi-label classification.
- Conduct model evaluation, benchmarking, hyperparameter optimization, and performance tuning.
- You will also be responsible for creating and optimizing core modules of the MLOps platform, from the computation layer to the orchestrator layer.
- Collaborate with software engineers to integrate ML models into production applications.
- Manage and oversee the AI vendor’s deliverables, including reviewing training approaches and datasets, and leading testing/UAT to evaluate and validate model accuracy and performance against business requirements.
requirements:

ML & Computer Vision Expertise

- Design and maintain scalable end-to-end ML pipelines for automated vision processing (symbol detection, drawing interpretation, floor plan parsing, quantity extraction from PDFs/CAD/blueprints).

- Strong written and spoken English

- Thiết kế database (SQL Server / PostgreSQL/Oracle) đảm bảo hiệu năng và tính toàn vẹn dữ liệu
- Tích hợp các hệ thống bên thứ ba: LDAP/AD, hệ thống lương, ERP, phần mềm chấm công
- Đảm bảo bảo mật hệ thống: xác thực OAuth2/JWT, phân quyền RBAC, mã hóa dữ liệu nhạy cảm

3. Triển khai & Vận hành

- Lập kế hoạch triển khai chi tiết theo từng phase (Waterfall): phân tích yêu cầu → thiết kế → phát triển → kiểm thử → nghiệm thu → go-live; quản lý rủi ro và đảm bảo tiến độ
- Thiết lập CI/CD pipeline (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions / Jenkins)
- Triển khai và cấu hình môi trường: On-premise/Azure/AWS
- Xây dựng quy trình kiểm thử, đảm bảo chất lượng (unit test, integration test, UAT)
- Phối hợp với bộ phận HR và Business Analyst để thu thập và chuẩn hóa yêu cầu nghiệp vụ

4. Tài liệu & Chuyển giao

- Viết tài liệu kỹ thuật: kiến trúc, API spec, hướng dẫn vận hành
- Thực hiện đào tạo và chuyển giao hệ thống cho đội vận hành (IT Ops)
- Hỗ trợ hypercare sau go-live, xử lý sự cố và tối ưu hiệu năng
requirements:
1. Kỹ năng kỹ thuật bắt buộc

- Thành thạo C# / .NET 9 (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, Minimal API)
- Thành thạo Angular (v16+): component architecture, RxJS, NgRx, Angular Material
- Kinh nghiệm thiết kế Microservices, RESTful API, gRPC
- SQL Server: query optimization, stored procedure, indexing, execution plan
- Kiến thức Oracle Database là lợi thế lớn (PL/SQL, Oracle-specific optimization)
- Kinh nghiệm với Azure / AWS hoặc môi trường cloud tương đương
- Hiểu biết vững về Design Patterns, SOLID, Clean Architecture / DDD
- CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes
- Bảo mật: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, mã hóa dữ liệu

2. Kỹ năng ưu tiên

- Khả năng giao tiếp, trình bày rõ ràng với stakeholder không chuyên kỹ thuật

title: [Middle/ Senior] Applied AI Engineer (Good English)
reasons:
- Highly Competitive Salary & Benefits
- Clear Career Growth & Learning Opportunities
- Partner with Top-tier Financial Institutions
jobDescription:
We are building AI-powered products for real-world business use cases, focusing on Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and domain specific model fine-tuning. As a Middle/Senior AI Engineer, you will take ownership of complex AI systems, mentor junior engineers, lead technical decisions, and drive the quality and scalability of our AI products from design to production.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and maintenance of AI-powered products using Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Architect and own end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for complex business applications.
- Design and build sophisticated AI Agents and multi-step AI workflows for real-world production use cases.
- Lead fine-tuning of domain-specific models using LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, or similar approaches; define fine-tuning strategies.
- Architect, curate, and govern datasets for model training and evaluation; establish data quality standards.
- Design and own evaluation and benchmarking pipelines to measure AI quality, accuracy, and performance at scale.
- Research, evaluate, and productionize new AI techniques, open-source models, and agent-based systems.
- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and middle-level engineers.
- Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business teams to define AI solutions and drive delivery.
- Define and enforce testing, documentation, and AI engineering best practices across the team.
- Contribute to architectural decisions, technical roadmaps, and AI strategy.
requirements:
Mandatory Requirements

- Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 3 – 6+ years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering, with at least 2 years at a senior level.
- Expert-level Python programming skills; solid understanding of software design principles.
- Deep hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and production RAG systems.
- Proven track record of building and shipping AI applications or AI-powered products in real-world, production environments.
- Strong familiarity with open-source LLMs such as Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Mistral, or similar models.
- Solid experience with LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, PEFT, AI evaluation and benchmarking, and dataset preparation for AI training.
- Deep understanding of prompt engineering, AI application design, and AI system architecture.
- Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical projects end-to-end.
- Strong English communication skills — both reading and writing; able to communicate technical concepts clearly.
- Strong problem-solving, ownership mindset, and ability to drive decisions under ambiguity.

Nice To Have

- Experience with AI Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, MCP, or similar agentic frameworks.
- Experience leading fine-tuning projects for domain-specific open-source models at scale.
- Experience designing and maintaining evaluation and benchmark pipelines in production.
- Experience with synthetic data generation, data flywheel design, and dataset curation strategies.
- Experience working with OCR, document processing, or knowledge extraction systems.
- Experience contributing to open-source AI projects or communities.
- Experience building and growing AI products with a significant active user base.
- Experience with MLOps, model serving infrastructure, or AI system observability

What You Will Work On

- Owning and scaling production-grade AI products and architectures.
- Defining and leading AI workflows and AI Agent system design.
- Driving fine-tuning and evaluation strategies for domain-specific AI models.
- Building enterprise-grade RAG systems that power real business outcomes.
- Dataset engineering, AI quality evaluation, and continuous model improvement loops.
- End-to-end AI product development lifecycle — from research to production.
benefits:
- 13th month salary based on exact time available monthly working at INNOTECH.
- Budget for team building each quarter / kick-off project.
- Premium Health Care Package - PVI for all employees.
- Laptop and monitor provided.
- Performance bonus plan.
- Employee referral bonus: 2,000,000 – 10,000,000 VND (depending on level / roles).
- Holiday celebrations.
- Teambuilding events.
- Annual Company Trips / Year-End Party.
- Sport activities.
- Support for learning and professional certificates

- Có khả năng làm việc nhóm và trao đổi kỹ thuật
benefits:
Thực hiện hoài bão xây dựng một ngân hàng tiên phong cho người Việt, TPBank mong muốn kết hợp sự thân thiện vốn có của người Việt Nam, tính chuyên nghiệp mang tầm quốc tế và Công nghệ cao để tạo nên nền tảng một ngân hàng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam. Tương lai nghề nghiệp vững chắc; các lãnh đạo nhiệt huyết và giàu kinh nghiệm; đồng nghiệp chia sẻ, cởi mở và thân thiện; môi trường làm việc hiện đại, chuyên nghiệp… và đặc biệt là chính sách nhân sự chuyên nghiệp với các chế độ đãi ngộ tài chính và phi tài chính mang tính toàn diện và hấp dẫn là những điều TPBank mong muốn mang đến cho toàn cán bộ nhân viên.

CHÍNH SÁCH NHÂN SỰ:

- Được đào tạo và phát triển sự nghiệp trong môi trường công nghệ tiên tiến, chuyên nghiệp, Ngân hàng Số hàng đầu tại Việt Nam.
- Thu nhập hấp dẫn, lộ trình phát triển sự nghiệp bền vững.
- Bên cạnh chính sách đãi ngộ về tài chính, TPBank còn có các gói phúc lợi và đãi ngộ phi tài chính hiệu quả đảm bảo cho cán bộ nhân viên sức khỏe, hạnh phúc và một tương lai tài chính ổn định lâu dài.

CHẾ ĐỘ ĐÃI NGỘ TÀI CHÍNH:

Chính sách đãi ngộ dành cho Cán bộ nhân viên (CBNV) chính thức của TPBank gồm có:

- Lương
- Phụ cấp: Phụ cấp trang điểm (dành cho CBNV nữ), Phụ cấp ăn trưa, Phụ cấp xăng xe/đi lại, Phụ cấp điện thoại, Phụ cấp độc hại.
- Chế độ phúc lơi: TPBank tặng quà hoặc tiền mặt cho CBNV nhân ngày lễ, tết: Ngày Quốc tế lao động, ngày Quốc Khánh, Tết Nguyên đán, Tết Dương lịch, Ngày Quốc tế Phụ nữ, Ngày phụ nữ Việt Nam, Ngày thành lập ngân hàng, ngày sinh nhật CBNV; Tết trung thu/Ngày Quốc tế Thiếu nhi (dành cho con CBNV)...
- Lương kinh doanh: là phần thưởng trên phần hiệu quả cho nhóm nhân viên trực tiếp kinh doanh theo chỉ tiêu được giao hàng tháng hoặc quý.
- Thưởng hiệu quả hàng năm: TPBank trả thưởng hàng năm cho CBNV theo kết quả kinh doanh của ngân hàng và đánh giá hiệu quả làm việc của CBNV.

CHẾ ĐỘ ĐÃI NGỘ PHI TÀI CHÍNH:

Chính sách đãi ngộ phi tài chính dành cho cán bộ nhân viên (CBNV) chính thức của TPBank như sau:

- Chương trình chăm sóc sức khỏe định kỳ và đặc biệt (AON Care);
- Chương trình nghỉ mát hàng năm.
- Chế độ nghỉ phép: 12 ngày, 14 ngày, 16 ngày hoặc 18 ngày tùy từng cấp CBNV. Ngoài ra, tại TPBank, các tổ chức Công đoàn, Đoàn thanh niên, Nhóm hoạt động tình nguyện Hearts in Hand, và các nhóm thành viên khác được tổ chức và hoạt động thường xuyên. Các chương trình sinh hoạt đoàn thể được tổ chức ngoài giờ làm việc góp phần tạo nên không khí vui tươi, thân thiện, sẻ chia cho cán bộ nhân viên TPBank.
- Đặc biệt, các chương trình hoạt động cộng đồng mang tính nhân đạo xã hội cũng thường xuyên được tổ chức và nhận được sự hưởng ứng nhiệt tình của cán bộ nhân viên TPBank.

Tại TPBank, "Mỗi nhân viên là một tài sản quý giá". TPBank luôn chào đón các bạn ứng viên, những người muốn đến với chúng tôi bằng tài năng, trí tuệ, phẩm chất đạo đức và lòng say mê công việc. Đến với TPBank, chúng tôi sẽ tạo cho bạn những cơ hội và thử thách để bạn tự khẳng định mình bằng chính tài năng của bạn.

Bởi lẽ, Vì chúng tôi hiểu bạn.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Python, SQL)
jobDescription:
About the Role

You will own the pipelines that move every event, transaction, and Change Data Capture (CDC) record from our products into a ClickHouse lakehouse and back out to the tools that act on it. Concretely, you own the medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) that turns raw events and revenue postbacks into the curated, aggregated tables that power Business Intelligence (BI), marketing attribution, and our emerging Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence (ML/AI) workloads.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end data engineering role on a modern open-source stack — not a narrow ticket-taking position. You will touch ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, and activation, and you will be the person who decides how a given dataset should be modeled and served.

What You'll Work On

Ingestion & event collection

- Maintain and extend event collection through RudderStack (our Customer Data Platform), PostHog, GA4, and server-side event sources across the web app and mobile apps
- Land raw revenue events from Stripe and Apple In-App Purchase (IAP) postbacks reliably and idempotently — billing data has zero tolerance for loss or duplication.

Integration & storage

- Run Airbyte connectors, including Change Data Capture from internal production databases, into the AWS S3 data lake.
- Manage the S3 → ClickHouse load path and keep the lake organized, partitioned, and costefficient.

Transformation — the medallion core

- Build and operate the Bronze → Silver → Gold pipelines in ClickHouse.
- Make correct use of ClickHouse engine families: ReplacingMergeTree for deduplicated, CDC-driven Silver tables and AggregatingMergeTree for the Gold aggregates that BI and ML consume.
- Model subscription-domain data — trials, conversions, Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), churn, Lifetime Value (LTV) — so that one number means one thing everywhere.

Orchestration & reliability

- Author, schedule, and monitor pipelines in Apache Airflow.
- Build data-quality checks, freshness Service Level Agreements (SLAs), alerting, and lineage so failures are caught before stakeholders see them.

Activation & reverse pipelines

- Sync curated data out to BigQuery and to the activation layer: ad platforms for conversion tracking (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Ads, and the TikTok/Reddit Ads channels as they come online), plus Braze, Singular, and Firebase.
- Feed the Gold layer to AWS QuickSight dashboards and prepare clean, well-documented feature tables for ML/AI use cases.
requirements:
Required

- 7+ years building production data pipelines, with strong, idiomatic SQL and Python.
- Hands-on experience with a columnar analytical warehouse — ClickHouse strongly preferred.
- Solid grasp of dimensional / medallion data modeling and when to denormalize, dedup, or preaggregate.
- Experience orchestrating pipelines with Apache Airflow.
- Experience with an Extract-Load-Transform (ELT) / ingestion tool — Airbyte preferred — and a working understanding of Change Data Capture.
- Comfort on AWS, especially S3 as a data lake.
- Track record of treating data quality, observability, and idempotency as first-class — not afterthoughts.
benefits:
- Full gross salary from Day 1 of Probation (2 months)
- Annual performance-based bonus (discretionary)
- Compulsory Social, Health & Unemployment Insurance from Day 1 of Probation
- Supplemental health insurance — Allianz / Bảo Việt
- MacBook provided for work
- 12 days paid annual leave/year, +1 day per 5 consecutive years
- Public holidays per Vietnamese law

- Free parking

title: Data Tech Lead (SQL, Python, Data Modeling, AWS)
jobDescription:
About the Role

The Tech Lead, Data Engineering is the technical head of the Data Stream and the architect behind our data foundation. You will lead a team responsible for ensuring that every AI-powered feature, personalization engine, and business insight operates on validated, high-performance data infrastructure.

Your scope spans the full data lifecycle — from event ingestion through transformation, storage, and delivery — up to the Feature Store and Vector DB level, providing a clean handoff to the Platform stream. title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Next.js & NestJS)
jobDescription:
We are building a high-performance B2B platform where business logic and data integrity are paramount. We are looking for a Senior Engineer who can bridge the gap between complex system requirements and production-ready code.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- System Architecture: Lead the implementation of scalable backend patterns using NestJS. You will be responsible for enforcing Clean Architecture boundaries and transitioning monolithic modules into decoupled services where necessary.
- Database Stewardship: Lead the database restructuring initiative. You will design normalized schemas, plan migration strategies to minimize downtime, and optimize complex queries for performance at scale.
- Advanced Frontend Engineering: Architect the Next.js 14+ frontend application. You will define patterns for Server Actions, caching strategies, and reusable component composition to ensure high performance (Core Web Vitals).
- Technical Leadership: Establish coding standards, conduct rigorous code reviews, and mentor mid-level developers. You are the "Quality Gatekeeper."
requirements:
Backend & Data

- Framework: Expert mastery of Node.js and NestJS. You understand the event loop, streams, and memory management deeply.
- Database: Advanced proficiency in PostgreSQL.

Frontend

- Framework: Expert knowledge of React.js and Next.js (App Router). You can explain the architectural trade-offs between SSR, CSR, and ISR in depth.
- UI Architecture: Ability to build complex, compound components using headless libraries (shadcn/ui, Radix UI) and Tailwind CSS.
- Performance: Experience debugging render cycles, memory leaks, and optimizing bundle sizes.

Tools & Workflow

- AI-Assisted Coding: You treat AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude) as a force multiplier. You know how to prompt for architectural patterns and rigorously audit the output for security and logic flaws.

Mindset & Work Ethic

- Product-Oriented: You don‘t just write code; you build products. You proactively identify gaps in the requirements and suggest improvements that align with business goals.
- Extreme Attention to Detail: You care about "invisible" quality—error handling, logging, data consistency, and edge cases. You assume things will break and code defensively.
- Outcome-Focused: You value shipping robust software over debating tools. You make pragmatic technical trade-offs and can articulate why you made them.
- Independent & High Agency: You can take a vague requirement like "Improve search accuracy" and turn it into a concrete technical roadmap without needing to be managed.
- Scientific Rigor: You don‘t guess; you measure. You use metrics and logs to prove your optimizations work.

English Reading Comprehension: Ability to read and understand English documents (equivalent to CEFR B1 level or above)

Nice to Have

- Experience designing Microservices or Event-Driven Architectures (Kafka, Debezium).
- Experience with Monorepo tooling (Turborepo/Nx) in a production environment.
- Deep knowledge of Authentication protocols (OAuth2, OIDC) and security best practices (OWASP).
benefits:

- 13th-month salary (applicable from the probationary period).
- Company-provided equipment.
- Well-stocked pantry: tea, coffee, snacks, microwave, etc.
- Engaging company activities: Company trips, team-building events, regular internal events (including live music performances!), and access to company-sponsored badminton courts.

jobDescription:
🎯 About the role

We are building a next-generation internal SOC platform focused on large-scale log processing and querying, detection & alerting pipelines, and incident response automation (SOAR). This role is for engineers who want to build security systems from the ground up — from ingestion to detection to response — rather than simply operating a SOC.

You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, security detection, and automation, with a focus on applying AI to reduce noise and accelerate incident handling.

🧠 What You’ll Do

- Design and build security monitoring, detection, and alerting systems
- Architect and develop large-scale log processing pipelines (ingestion → detection → alerting)
- Develop detection logic and continuously improve alert quality
- Build and automate Incident Response workflows (SOAR)
- Optimize storage, querying, and processing performance for security data
- Research and integrate open-source solutions within the SOC ecosystem
- Design log collection architecture and strategy across Kubernetes, VMs, and cloud environments

🚀 Key Projects

- Build an end-to-end internal SOC platform (ingestion → detection → response)
- Apply AI/ML to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives
- Optimize performance and scalability of the log processing infrastructure
requirements:
🌟Must-have

- Experience building or operating systems related to logging, monitoring, security, or SOC
- Experience working with distributed systems or high-throughput backend infrastructure
- Proficiency in Golang and/or Java in a production environment

🧩Nice to Have

- Hands-on experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, or real-world SOC environments
- Understanding and practical application of MITRE ATT&CK in detection engineering
- Experience processing large-scale logs using ELK, ClickHouse, Kafka, or similar
- Experience with or strong interest in applying AI/ML in security contexts
benefits:
Inside our lean engineering team:

- We work on large and complex systems, with a focus on ownership and continuous learning.
- We work within existing constraints and improve systems incrementally.
- We value strong fundamentals and the ability to reason through unfamiliar or complex systems.
- Collaboration is direct, and discussions focus on solving problems and delivering results.

Our offers include:

- MacBook provided
- Full salary insurance
- Health care insurance
- 19 leave days
- Annual health check-up

jobDescription:
VỀ ONE MOUNT

One Mount được thành lập với tham vọng xây dựng hệ sinh thái công nghệ lớn nhất Việt Nam, cung cấp các giải pháp và dịch vụ xuyên suốt chuỗi giá trị từ lĩnh vực dịch vụ tài chính, phân phối, bất động sản và bán lẻ. Với thế mạnh về năng lực công nghệ và dữ liệu, One Mount là mảnh ghép quan trọng cùng Techcombank và Masterise Group xây dựng một hệ sinh thái đa chiều, mang đến nhiều giá trị cho khách hàng, đối tác và toàn thị trường.

MÔ TẢ VỊ TRÍ

- Chúng tôi đang tìm một Senior Software Engineer/Technical Lead Engineer thực chiến. Ở vị trí này, bạn phát triển sản phẩm và sử dụng AI như một lực lượng thực thi chính: tập trung vào việc phân tích đề bài, định hình giải pháp và thiết kế hệ thống, sử dụng AI để tạo ra sản phẩm chất lượng. Đây là vai trò nhấn mạnh tư duy thiết kế và ra quyết định kỹ thuật, bạn sử dụng AI giúp hiện thực hóa nhanh hơn, chất lượng hơn.
- Đây là vị trí hướng đến trở thành một product builder tự chủ — một engineer vận hành gần như một đội nhỏ nhờ biết khai thác AI hiệu quả trong phát triển phần mềm. Chúng tôi không đặt nặng một ngôn ngữ cụ thể — quan trọng là bạn có nền tảng tư duy hệ thống vững, tư duy sản phẩm và khả năng dẫn dắt, kiểm chứng AI.
- Chúng tôi sẵn sàng chào đón ứng viên ở cấp bậc Senior Software Engineer hoặc Technical Lead Engineer, dựa trên kết quả đánh giá năng lực và bề dày kinh nghiệm thực tế của bạn

MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC

- Sở hữu việc xây dựng một sản phẩm hoặc luồng sản phẩm: định hình giải pháp, triển khai và bàn giao kết quả chạy được; phối hợp với Product Owner ở khâu yêu cầu và QC ở khâu kiểm thử.
- Sử dụng AI làm lực lượng thực thi chính trong phát triển phần mềm: biết khai thác AI hiệu quả, dẫn dắt và biết can thiệp, xử lý khi cần — bạn dẫn dắt, AI thực thi.
- Phân rã bài toán, điều phối và dẫn dắt các AI Coding Tools để tạo ra kết quả nhanh và chất lượng.
- Đọc, phản biện và kiểm chứng (verify) đầu ra của AI: đảm bảo tính đúng đắn, an toàn, hiệu năng và sự nhất quán về kiến trúc.
- Đảm bảo chất lượng đầu ra: thiết lập tiêu chí nghiệm thu và phối hợp với QC trong kiểm thử.
- Hiểu và giữ vững hệ thống: nắm kiến trúc tổng thể, nhận diện và xử lý technical debt, refactor khi cần.
- Chủ động khám phá và áp dụng các công cụ, kỹ thuật AI mới để nâng năng suất và chất lượng.
- Phối hợp với Product Owner và các bên liên quan để thống nhất hướng giải pháp và ưu tiên.

Với cấp Technical Lead Engineer, bạn còn tham gia cải tiến quy trình và framework làm việc chung của nhóm, đặt chuẩn chất lượng và review, đồng thời mentor các thành viên — bên cạnh việc trực tiếp hands-on.
requirements:
CHÚNG TÔI CẦN

- Tư duy hệ thống và thiết kế: hiểu cách một hệ thống vận hành (data flow, dependency, điểm nghẽn, điểm gãy) và biết cách thiết kế hệ thống; đọc và nắm nhanh một codebase hoặc kiến trúc lạ.
- Tư duy sản phẩm: hiểu “tại sao” đằng sau mỗi yêu cầu, cân nhắc trade-off, và tự ra quyết định triển khai hợp lý khi yêu cầu chưa đủ chi tiết.
- Tư duy logic và giải quyết vấn đề: phân rã bài toán lớn thành các phần rõ ràng; nhận ra khi nào một kết quả “nghe có vẻ đúng” nhưng thực ra sai.
- Năng lực làm việc với AI: đã dùng AI Coding Tools thực tế để tạo ra kết quả chạy được; thành thạo ít nhất một công cụ và sẵn sàng dùng nhiều công cụ. Hiểu rõ cách khai thác AI hiệu quả trong phát triển phần mềm — cung cấp đúng ngữ cảnh (context), dẫn dắt và biết can thiệp, xử lý khi cần.
- Tinh thần thực chiến và tự chủ: Luôn sẵn sàng trực tiếp tham gia giải quyết vấn đề, có khả năng tự chủ tìm tòi và tận dụng sức mạnh của AI để vượt qua thử thách kỹ thuật (học hỏi hoặc nghiên cứu techstack mới).
- Nền tảng kỹ thuật đủ để ra quyết định: nắm các khái niệm cốt lõi như API design, database (SQL/NoSQL), caching, messaging/queue, đồng bộ và bất đồng bộ — đủ để phản biện và kiểm chứng AI (không bắt buộc thuộc lòng cú pháp một ngôn ngữ cụ thể).
- Tự quản lý công việc: biết ưu tiên, ước lượng và giao tiếp tiến độ (Không yêu cầu kinh nghiệm quản lý nhân sự).

YÊU CẦU CÔNG VIỆC

- Có khả năng tự phân tích yêu cầu và kiểm thử (bên cạnh việc phối hợp với PO và QC).
- Ít nhất 7 năm kinh nghiệm Backend (Java - Spring Boot).
- Microservices hoặc Modular Monolith, event-driven, cloud-native; SQL/NoSQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB); Redis, Kafka; Docker/Kubernetes.
- Kinh nghiệm với hệ thống high-performance, low-latency, real-time transactions.
- Hiểu biết về web và ứng dụng mobile.
- Quen các nền tảng AI-native: agentic workflow, MCP (Model Context Protocol), evals/guardrails.
benefits:

title: [Remote] Web Developer — Digital Twin Platform
jobDescription:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Web Developer — Digital Twin Platform to join our team on a freelance contract basis.This position is being advertised through our recruitment partner in Vietnam. The successful candidate will provide services to a Singapore-based technology company and will work closely with our regional team on project delivery and client engagements.

You will be expected to take ownership of core editor capabilities: 2D/3D views, semantic graph interactions, performance-sensitive visualization, and data-heavy workflows.

This is not a marketing website role; it is a deeply technical web application.

What you will work on

You will contribute directly to the core of or product development including:

- A React + TypeScript application that serves as the main authoring interface
- A Three.js–based 3D engine used for spatial visualization, navigation, and editing
- Data-intensive UI flows for: Asset creation and editing Semantic relationships (upstream / downstream graphs) Tagging, filtering, and class management Project-scale operations (import, export, duplication, versioning)
- Asset creation and editing
- Semantic relationships (upstream / downstream graphs)
- Tagging, filtering, and class management
- Project-scale operations (import, export, duplication, versioning)
- Performance-critical rendering and interaction patterns across large building models
- Tight coupling between semantic data (Brick / RDF-like graphs) and spatial representations (2D/3D)

Key responsibilities

- Design and implement complex React + TypeScript interfaces for a professional-grade editor
- Build and maintain interactive 2D and 3D views using Three.js, with a strong focus on performance and usability
- Implement editor workflows such as drag-and-drop, visual linking, inspectors, trees, and graph-like interactions
- Work with large, structured datasets (assets, relationships, tags, classes, locations) backed by SQL
- Ensure consistency between semantic models and visual representations
- Collaborate on data ingestion and export pipelines (CSV, JSON, IFC, semantic formats)
- Participate in architectural decisions around state management, data flow, and rendering strategies
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-typed code that can evolve with a long-lived product
- Debug and optimize performance issues across rendering, data handling, and UI state
requirements:
Required technical skills

You should be very solid in the following areas:

- TypeScript — strong typing discipline, not just “JS with types”
- React — building complex, state-heavy applications
- Three.js — this is critical

You should be comfortable with scenes, cameras, controls, geometries, instancing, picking, transforms, and performance trade-offs

- SQL — strong understanding of relational data modeling, querying, and data integrity
- Rust — used for performance-sensitive logic, tooling, or backend-adjacent components

You should also have basic but real familiarity with:

- AWS — understanding how web applications are deployed and operated in the cloud
- Kubernetes — you don’t need to be an expert; the platform and workflows can be taught (as has been done successfully before)

Nice to have (but not required)

- Experience with graph-like data structures or knowledge graphs
- Background in GIS, BIM, IFC Digital Twins, or Civil / infrastructure software
- Experience optimizing large-scale Three.js scenes
- Familiarity with RDF, ontologies, or semantic modeling concepts
- Familiarity with Brick Schema
- Familiarity with OpenBIM, IFC.JS, Fragments
benefits:
- Very attractive salary commensurate with experience, plus performance-based bonuses.
- Clear career development path with opportunities to grow into Engineering Manager or Principal Engineer roles.
- Access to the latest technologies, tools, and AI-assisted development platforms.
- Opportunity for business trips to Singapore and engagement with strategic partners.
- Work alongside a friendly, experienced, and highly talented team.
- Professional, collaborative, and supportive working environment.
- Work-from-home arrangement.

title: QA Engineer — VibeX-Generated Apps (QA QC, Tester)
reasons:
